en: \n\nVault Potions are upgraded Vials, and they can hold one modifier

zh: \n请将此问题报告给 Vault Hunters 官方 Discord！

en: The Garden Cloche can grow crops for you using power (FE) to very quickly make simple farms of most growable blocks in Minecraft.
zh: 园艺钟罩可使用 Forge 能量（FE）为你种植作物，非常快速地制作大多数可种植方块的简单农场。

en: The Phytogenic Insulator can duplicate/generate a lot of farmable items for you using power (FE).
zh: 植育绝缘机可使用 Forge 能量（FE）为你复制/生成大量可种植物品。

en: &5 -Vault Gear, Skill Scrolls, Vault Modifiers, Vault Fruit, Food, and Blocks
zh: &5 -宝库装备、技能卷轴、宝库修饰词、宝库水果、食物和方块

en: &5 ...but are quite cheap. Usually just some Emeralds and some XP levels.
zh: &5……但通常很便宜，一般只需要一些绿宝石和经验等级。

en: &5...and the Soul Diffusor is already a bit pricy at low level.
zh: &5……而灵魂扩散器本身在低等级时已经不便宜了。

en: &5...different things, depending on what mods you have Researched so far.
zh: &5……不同的东西，取决于你目前研究了哪些模组。

en: &5...or unlucky. You might need a more versatile build for Bingo Vaults, but that's up to you.
zh: &5……或者运气变差。宾果宝库可能需要更全能的构筑，不过这由你决定。

en: &5...The Repair Augmenter might be useful to you. Using this, you can add an extra Repair slot to a piece of gear.
zh: &5……修复增幅器也许会帮到你。使用它可以给一件装备增加额外的修复槽。

en: &5...well, and a Random Item option at a fixed price. You can unlock the three slots on the right with the right Expertise.
zh: &5……当然，还有一个固定价格的随机物品选项。右侧三个栏位可以通过合适的专精解锁。

en: &5"Rolling" every single piece of gear sounds fun to me, but most folks find it tedious after a while. So, enter the Identification Stand.
zh: &5我觉得把每一件装备都“掷出”很有趣，但大多数人过一阵子会嫌麻烦。于是，鉴定台登场了。

en: &5(Alternately, having the keys in a Backpack with an Activator Upgrade is another option...)
zh: &5（或者，把钥匙放进带激活升级的背包里也是一种选择……）

en: &5&lDue to a bug, skill altars are disabled by default. They can be re-enabled via a gamerule.
zh: &5&l由于一个漏洞，技能祭坛默认被禁用。可以通过游戏规则重新启用。

en: &5&lNOTE: Antique stamps will not drop unless you have this Book equipped in your Curios!
zh: &5&l注意：除非你在 Curios 中装备了这本收藏册，否则古董邮票不会掉落！

en: &5&lServers can disable placing Vault Dolls and require using Doll Blenders, as Vault Dolls with high amounts of loot can crash servers. Change the gamerule enablePlacingVaultDolls to false!
zh: &5&l服务器可以禁用放置宝库娃娃，并要求使用娃娃搅拌机，因为装有大量战利品的宝库娃娃可能导致服务器崩溃。把游戏规则 enablePlacingVaultDolls 改为 false 即可！

en: &5&lThe Filter Necklace unlocks with the Void Crucible research!
zh: &5&l过滤项链会随虚空坩埚研究一起解锁！

en: &51) Underground, both spawn around Y -30. Look in caves and tunnels, especially around lava.
zh: &51）地下：两者都会在 Y -30 附近生成。多找洞穴和矿道，尤其是熔岩附近。

en: &52) Above ground, ruined Vault Portals spawn occasionally. They are a good early source for both.
zh: &52）地表：偶尔会生成废弃宝库传送门，它们是前期获取这两种材料的好来源。

en: &5A big stepping stone, aye. A lot opens up to ya. New vaults, new mechanics, new loot, etc.
zh: &5这是一个重要阶段，没错。许多内容会向你开放：新宝库、新机制、新战利品等等。

en: &5A big tip for early game : a good source for many crops and plant items is the Farming for Blockheads Market block!
zh: &5前期小提示：想获得各种作物和植物物品，方块小镇农夫市场是很好的来源！

en: &5A cool thing happens if you remove ALL the tool abilities. No Picking, no Axing, etc.
zh: &5如果移除所有工具能力，会发生一件很酷的事：没有挖掘、没有砍伐，什么都没有。

en: &5A good strategy is to go as far as ye can before the enemies get TOO deadly, then loop back and loot before leaving.
zh: &5一个好策略是尽可能往前推进，直到敌人变得太致命，然后绕回来搜刮并离开。

en: &5A good thing to keep in mind is each time you reroll or modify a piece of Vault Gear, you lower its "Crafting Potential" stat.
zh: &5请记住，每次重掷或修改一件宝库装备，都会降低它的“制作潜力”属性。

en: &5A new piece of equipment that'll start showing up, albeit very rarely, is Vault Trinkets, and you can find them usually in Gilded Chests.
zh: &5一种新的装备会开始出现，虽然非常稀有：宝库饰品。它们通常可以在镀金宝箱中找到。

en: &5A really good box should start showing up for you from various sources.
zh: &5一个非常棒的盒子会开始从各种来源出现。

en: &5A semi uncommon bit of loot to find is the Mystery Box.
zh: &5神秘箱是一种不算特别常见的战利品。

en: &5A special mob egg can be obtained by completing the Brutal Bosses objective.
zh: &5完成残暴首领目标可获得一种特殊生物蛋。

en: &5A wide variety of peaceful mobs are available from Mystery Eggs, which drop them as 'Spawn Eggs'.
zh: &5神秘蛋可以产出各种和平生物，并以“刷怪蛋”的形式掉落。

en: &5Abilities are your activatable skills. Throw a fireball, teleport, etc. For example, the Veinmine skill is only active while holding down the Vault Ability button when you mine something.
zh: &5技能是可以主动触发的能力，例如丢火球、传送等。比如连锁挖掘只有在挖掘时按住宝库技能键才会生效。

en: &5About Scav Vaults! In these, you get a list of items you need to find in THAT vault specifically. They'll be at the top of your screen, with an icon of where to find them: from either chests, monsters, or ores.
zh: &5关于拾荒宝库：你会获得一份只在当前宝库中寻找的物品清单。它们会显示在屏幕顶部，并带有来源图标：宝箱、怪物或矿石。

en: &5Affinity is, hm... basicaly showing favor to one of the four Vault Gods : Idona, Wendarr, Tenos, and Velara.
zh: &5亲和，嗯……基本上代表你对四位宝库神之一的偏向：伊多娜、温达尔、特诺斯和维拉拉。

en: &5After level 25, they have a chance of having Lucky Hit Chance on them.
zh: &525 级之后，头盔有机会出现幸运一击几率。

en: &5After that? Well, it's time to get Greedy...
zh: &5在那之后？嗯，就该变得更贪婪一点了……

en: &5After the loadout, Tommy will offer you two sets of Trinkets, which you can select one from each group. And finally, a choice of reward for completing the Royale Vault.
zh: &5选择配置后，Tommy 会提供两组饰品，每组你可以各选一个。最后还会让你选择完成大逃杀宝库后的奖励。

en: &5After the Vault, give the doll back to the friend. They can Right Click the Doll onto the ground to release it. CAREFUL, do this in an enclosed area!
zh: &5宝库结束后，把娃娃还给朋友。朋友可以把娃娃右键放到地上释放它。小心，请在封闭区域内操作！

en: &5Alchemy is a twist on Scavenger Vaults : Looting chests and killing monsters will occasionally get you Alchemy ingredients, which you use to brew potions that add to a Completion Bar and add effects to the Vault.
zh: &5炼金是拾荒宝库的变体：搜刮箱子和击杀怪物时偶尔会获得炼金材料，你可以用它们酿造药剂，为完成条增加进度并给宝库添加效果。

en: &5All chests, all doors, and all Objective blocks (like the Lodestones or Braziers) will be visible in the same room. And uh....maybe further...
zh: &5同一房间内的所有宝箱、所有门和所有目标方块（例如磁石或火盆）都会可见。呃……也许范围还更远……

en: &5All of them will give you a bit of a Speed boost for a couple minutes.
zh: &5所有饮料都会给予几分钟的小幅速度提升。

en: &5All Vault Ores have a small chance of dropping Smashed Vault Gems instead of their respective gem.
zh: &5所有宝库矿石都有小几率掉落碎裂宝库宝石，而不是对应宝石。

en: &5Along with a more fluid combat system, Wold's Vaults adds a mod called Parcool. This enables your movement to include Parkour moves.
zh: &5除了更流畅的战斗系统，Wold 的宝库还加入了 Parcool 模组，让你的移动包含跑酷动作。

en: &5Along with being able to enable or disable Better Combat or Parcool, VH Vanilla and Wold's Vaults have various commands and gamerules you can change to customize your experience.
zh: &5除了可以开启或关闭 Better Combat、Parcool 外，原版 VH 和 Wold 的宝库还提供了多种命令与游戏规则，用来调整你的游玩体验。

en: &5Along with the map, I like to mark my path or interesting things with blocks that stand out. Take this Unobtanium, which you can duplicate by crafting it back into ingots then into blocks again. Try it!
zh: &5除了看地图，我也喜欢用显眼的方块标记路线或有趣地点。拿这个难得素块试试吧，它可以先分解成锭，再重新合成方块来复制数量。

en: &5Also in each room is a Crake Pedestal. Don't interact with it until you are ready to leave!
zh: &5每个房间还有一个蛋糕基座。除非你准备离开，否则不要互动！

en: &5Also keep an eye out for Diamonds, since you'll need some Obsidian as well.
zh: &5也记得留意钻石，因为你还需要一些黑曜石。

en: &5Also lots of your Focuses and things related to re-rolling and customizing your Vault Gear.
zh: &5这里也会出现许多聚焦器，以及用于重掷和定制宝库装备的相关物品。

en: &5Also, only one person can use each Lodestone! Keep that in mind if you are running with friends!
zh: &5另外，每个磁石只能被一个人使用！如果和朋友一起跑宝库，一定要记住这一点。

en: &5Also, there's some neat things you can do with Vault Maps, since they are considered Vault Gear...
zh: &5另外，由于宝库地图被视为宝库装备，你还能用它们做一些有趣的事……

en: &5Also, you can get a discount on Vendor Pedestals with a certain Expertise.
zh: &5另外，某个专精可以让你在商贩基座购买时获得折扣。

en: &5Alternate, harder versions of Vanilla VH Vault Objectives. Scavenger not challenging enough? Try Unhinged Scavenger!
zh: &5原版 VH 的宝库目标也有了更难的变体。拾荒还不够刺激？试试失控拾荒！

en: &5An Altar Recatalyzer will cancel a Greedy Rock Vault completely instead of rerolling it, in case you don't have the Vault materials needed.
zh: &5如果你没有所需的宝库材料，祭坛重催化器会完全取消贪婪宝库岩对应的宝库，而不是重掷它。

en: &5An helpful tool for navigating Vaults you can Research is the Vault Compass.
zh: &5宝库指南针是一种可以通过研究解锁的实用导航工具。

en: &5And each additional one expands your board. 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, etc.
zh: &5之后每额外添加一个，棋盘都会扩大：4x4、5x5、6x6，依此类推。

en: &5And each space is a different task. It could be loot certain types of chests.
zh: &5每个格子都是一个不同任务，可能要求你搜刮特定类型的箱子。

en: &5And if you are in Hardcore, there is no body, and no way to get your equipment back (outside of Server Commands)
zh: &5如果是硬核模式，就不会生成躯体，也无法取回装备（除非使用服务器命令）。

en: &5And if you happen to get a line? Something more significant happens.
zh: &5如果你碰巧连成一条线？会发生更重大的事情。

en: &5And most recently they added these Unique Crates. You can find em in those big crates in Factory Rooms, or in the catacombs beneath Village Rooms in the Vaults.
zh: &5最近还加入了独特奖励箱。你可以在工厂房间的大箱子里，或宝库村庄房间下方的地下墓穴中找到它们。

en: &5And note they have limited uses. Each time you enter a Vault with a trinket, it consumes a use.
zh: &5注意，它们有使用次数限制。每次带着饰品进入宝库都会消耗一次使用次数。

en: &5And the Demagnetizer will disable all Vault Magnets near it.
zh: &5而消磁器会禁用附近所有宝库磁铁。

en: &5Another is a charge up attack. You'll see glasses full of Time Sand or something in them. Run around and hit these before the charge up finishes!
zh: &5另一个阶段是蓄力攻击。你会看到装满时间沙之类东西的玻璃容器。四处跑动并在蓄力完成前击破它们！

en: &5Another new kind of Focus for your Vault Artisan Station : the Eccentric Focus.
zh: &5你的宝库工匠台又有一种新的聚焦器：异质聚焦器。

en: &5Another new type of Vault that opens up at level 50 is called the Vault Royale, a take on Battle Royale style games. You need to use a Royale Rock to create the crystal.
zh: &550 级解锁的另一种新宝库叫宝库大逃杀，灵感来自大逃杀类玩法。你需要使用大逃杀宝库岩来制作水晶。

en: &5Another warning if you have a group of people in an Enchanted Elixir vault : these 'events' can cascade off one of you to another, creating a deadly chain.
zh: &5如果多人一起跑附魔灵药宝库，再提醒一句：这些“事件”可能从一名玩家连锁到另一名玩家，形成致命连锁。

en: &5Applying this Capstone to a Vault Crystal will negate almost all Trap chances.
zh: &5将这个顶石应用到宝库水晶上，会几乎抵消所有陷阱几率。

en: &5Arcane Essence is used to craft Expertise Orbs, which let you increase your Expertise points beyond level 100.
zh: &5奥术精华用于制作专精宝珠，让你的专精点数在 100 级后继续增加。

en: &5Are you playing on a server with other players? Have one of you found that ultra rare transmog that everyone else wants?
zh: &5你在服务器上和其他玩家一起玩吗？你们中有人解锁了所有人都想要的超稀有幻化吗？

en: &5Around level 20, you'll start finding Vault Fruit in your Completion Crates and other sources.
zh: &5大约 20 级时，你会开始从完成奖励箱和其他来源找到宝库水果。

en: &5As for the hammer, you can use the Dehammerizer to disable the area effect of yer hammer. Save yourself a big headache.
zh: &5至于锤子，可以用禁锤器关闭锤子的范围效果，省掉很多头疼事。

en: &5As long as this Shard Pouch is in your main inventory (not stuck in a backpack), it should collect all the Soul Shards you get.
zh: &5只要碎片袋在你的主物品栏里（不是塞在背包里），它就会收集你获得的所有灵魂碎片。

en: &5As well, as you Research and unlock mods (more on that later!), certain resources may be added to the possible list of items!
zh: &5此外，当你研究并解锁模组后（这部分稍后再讲），某些资源也可能加入祭坛需求列表！

en: &5As well, each time you roll a new piece of gear, you have a higher chance of unlocking a Transmog you haven't obtained yet.
zh: &5此外，每次你掷出新装备，解锁尚未获得幻化的几率都会提高。

en: &5As well, you can remove a Trinket Pouch and it will keep the Trinkets you put into it, enabling you to swap in and out sets of Trinkets for different builds.
zh: &5此外，取下饰品袋时，它会保留其中放入的饰品，让你可以为不同构筑切换成套饰品。

en: &5As you collect Jewels, you'll find rarer ones that have multiple attributes on them. And sometimes, one of those attributes you just don't want, while everything else is great.
zh: &5收集珠宝时，你会找到更稀有、带多个属性的珠宝。有时其中一个属性你并不想要，而其他属性都很好。

en: &5As you get higher level, the broader variety of things you'll have access to. More powerful equipment, more skills, etc.
zh: &5等级越高，你能接触到的内容就越多：更强的装备、更多技能，以及各种新选择。

en: &5As you level higher, you will slow down in gaining levels, but increase the amount of equipment you find in a Vault.
zh: &5等级越高，升级速度会变慢，但你在宝库中找到的装备数量会增加。

en: &5As you level up and get more Skill points for Abilities and Talents, you'll start coming up with builds.
zh: &5随着等级提升，并获得更多用于技能和天赋的点数，你会开始构筑自己的玩法。

en: &5As you level up beyond 50, you'll start getting more and more resources, and start collecting Treasure Room Keys.
zh: &5等级超过 50 后，你会开始获得越来越多资源，并开始收集宝藏房钥匙。

en: &5As you level up, the amount of Vault Gear you find in the Vaults will increase. Especially if you tailor your skill and equipment to getting more loot.
zh: &5随着等级提高，你在宝库中找到的宝库装备数量会增加。如果你的技能和装备也偏向获取更多战利品，增长会更明显。

en: &5As you level up, you'll be gaining skill points every level, and Expertise points every 5 levels.
zh: &5随着等级提升，你每级都会获得技能点，每 5 级会获得 1 个专精点。

en: &5As you level, you'll unlock mods to make gathering materials for crystals easier.
zh: &5随着等级提升，你会解锁一些模组，让收集水晶材料变得更轻松。

en: &5As you progress, the Vaults get harder, and more costly to summon. Research new mods to help you, whether its to farm resources, sort your growing pile of loot, or just to have a break from the Vaults with some fun mods.
zh: &5随着进度推进，宝库会越来越难，召唤成本也会提高。你可以研究新的模组来帮忙，无论是生产资源、整理越来越多的战利品，还是暂时离开宝库玩点有趣的内容。

en: &5As you start rolling and gathering Vault Gear, you'll start coming across more interesting Affixes that may not be obvious what they do. Ones like Heart Frag Chance, or Echoing, are not self explanatory after all!
zh: &5当你开始掷出并收集宝库装备时，会遇到更多有趣但不太直观的词缀。比如心之碎片几率、回响之类，光看名字确实不好懂！

en: &5As you start to get higher level and get more gear and tools, you'll probably end up with a need to...turn off some of those tools in your Base.
zh: &5随着等级提高、装备和工具变多，你可能会开始需要……在基地里关掉某些工具效果。

en: &5At 50 there is another more normal Vault type that unlocks: Hunt the Runes.
zh: &550 级时会解锁另一种更常规的宝库类型：狩猎符文。

en: &5At around level 24 you'll start finding Catalyst fragments in Gilded Chests.
zh: &5大约 24 级时，你会开始在镀金宝箱中找到催化剂碎片。

en: &5At first, the Compass can only point to the Vault Portal, but as you explore more Vaults, you'll unlock the ability to point the Compass  at other things.
zh: &5一开始指南针只能指向宝库传送门；随着你探索更多宝库，会逐步解锁指向其他目标的能力。

en: &5At it's core, this modpack is an Extraction Looter : You enter a dungeon to get loot, and to keep the loot you must survive and extract. And by default, if you are level 20 or higher, if you die you lose your inventory, which you can purchase back by spending Vault Gold.
zh: &5本整合包的核心是撤离夺宝：进入地牢获取战利品，想保住战利品就必须活着撤离。默认情况下，20 级及以上死亡会失去背包物品，但可以花费宝库金币赎回。

en: &5At level 20, you start being able to have Block Chance or Mana on your Chestplates Implicits as well.
zh: &520 级后，你的胸甲固有词缀也可能出现格挡几率或法力。

en: &5At level 20, your Boots can start rolling Movement Speed as part of its Implicits.
zh: &520 级后，你的靴子固有词缀开始可能掷出移动速度。

en: &5At level 20, your Leggings can start rolling extra Mana in its Implicits.
zh: &520 级后，你的护腿固有词缀开始可能掷出额外法力。

en: &5At Level 65, you can start finding Vault Pendants in Ornate Chests and Barrels.
zh: &565 级时，你可以开始在华丽箱和木桶里找到宝库坠饰。

en: &5At the end of the Dungeon, it will spawn a special Champion, the boss of the dungeon. It's usually tankier than normal Champions, and drops some decent loot.
zh: &5地牢尽头会生成特殊冠军怪，也就是地牢首领。它通常比普通冠军怪更肉，并会掉落不错的战利品。

en: &5Axes prioritize Damage over Speed, and are the only weapon that does Reaving, which strikes for a percentage of extra HP damage on the first hit.
zh: &5斧更偏向伤害而非速度，也是唯一拥有劈砍的武器；劈砍会在首次命中时按额外生命值百分比造成伤害。

en: &5Battlestaves are the fast attacking weapon available. Each hit doesn't do as much damage, and wielding one disables anything in your Off Hand. To make up for this, the range and number of Affixes it can have is higher than other weapons.
zh: &5战杖是攻击速度很快的武器。每次命中伤害较低，使用时会禁用副手。作为补偿，它的攻击范围和可拥有词缀数量高于其他武器。

en: &5Be careful: One of these causes Wraiths and Ghosts to spawn in every room you enter. The other causes mob attacks to sap a little bit of your Vault Timer. Much like touching Void Liquid does.
zh: &5小心：其中一个会让幽魂和鬼魂在你进入的每个房间生成；另一个会让怪物攻击削减一点你的宝库计时器，类似接触虚空液体。

en: &5Be sure to follow along with the built-in Vault Hunters quests. They are somewhat out of date, but do give you some nice items to help you out.
zh: &5记得也跟着内置的宝库猎人任务一起做。那些任务有些内容已经过时，但会给你一些很实用的起步物品。

en: &5Be sure to look around before leaving. Especially under staircases.
zh: &5离开前一定四处看看，尤其是楼梯下面。

en: &5BE WARNED, these ingredients will be items found inside Vaults instead of outside!
zh: &5请注意，这些材料会是在宝库内部找到的物品，而不是外界物品！

en: &5Before some of these special workstations were added, you had to apply special items to a Crystal with an Anvil.
zh: &5在某些特殊工作站加入之前，你必须用铁砧把特殊物品应用到水晶上。

en: &5Blocks voided this way won't take durability from your Magnet.
zh: &5通过这种方式销毁的方块不会消耗磁铁耐久。

en: &5Both Imbued and Corrupted gear cannot be further modified in the Artisan Station.
zh: &5已灌注和已腐化的装备都无法在工匠站中继续修改。

en: &5Breaking it gives you a small chance at obtaining a Temporal Shard. These roll like other Vault Gear, and can have a powerful ability.
zh: &5打破晶塔有小几率获得时空碎片。这些碎片会像其他宝库装备一样掷出属性，并可能拥有强力能力。

en: &5Bring 'em to this Vault Trinket Forge, and combined with some other materials, you can forge a new Trinket from the ones you've already unlocked.
zh: &5把它们带到宝库饰品锻造台，再结合其他材料，就能从已解锁的饰品中锻造一个新的饰品。

en: &5But as you make more and more Vault Crystals, and as you level, this cost will go up, as will the variety of materials you will need.
zh: &5但随着你制作越来越多宝库水晶、等级不断提高，材料成本会增加，所需材料种类也会变多。

en: &5But at the same time, you're ability to loot more and faster should increase too, yeah?
zh: &5但与此同时，你搜刮得更多、更快的能力也应该会提升，对吧？

en: &5But good news is that the Unhinged Scavenger's Vault Theme will ALWAYS be Chaos. So any room type can show up, to ensure you can always find theme specific monsters like Endermen or Piglins.
zh: &5好消息是，失控拾荒的宝库主题永远是混沌。因此任何房间类型都可能出现，确保你总能找到末影人或猪灵这样的主题怪物。

en: &5But if you remember where that God Altar was, you can return to it to get a prize as well.
zh: &5如果你还记得神明祭坛的位置，也可以回去领取一份奖品。

en: &5But once you have the set number of Braziers, you can activate more to Pillage them for possible rare loot. But these will usually only have a bad Modifier as well.
zh: &5点够指定数量后，你还可以继续激活更多火盆来掠夺它们，可能获得稀有战利品。不过这些火盆通常也只会附带负面修饰词。

en: &5But sometimes you get a bad roll on a unique, or you upgrade past a unique and now have no use for it.
zh: &5但有时候独特物品掷得不好，或者你已经升级到不再需要某件独特物品。

en: &5But soon you'll be needing more complex ingredients. Enter the Chromatic Iron Vault Infuser. With this, you can infuse various Vault ingredients together into more powerful resources.
zh: &5但很快你会需要更复杂的材料。彩铁宝库灌注器就是为此准备的，它可以把各种宝库材料灌注成更强力的资源。

en: &5But that changes when you got Picking and Shoveling. Or Axing and Reaping. Or more of them.
zh: &5但当它同时有挖掘和铲掘，或砍伐和收割，或更多能力时，外形就会变化。

en: &5But thats the least of your worries. As you gather Elixir, random events will trigger at certain milestones. That goes for both yourself and any party members!
zh: &5但这只是小问题。收集灵药时，到达某些进度节点会触发随机事件。你自己和队伍成员都会触发！

en: &5But there is special layouts. One is used for Cake Vaults, the Spiral. Another makes an endless Vault.
zh: &5但也有特殊布局。蛋糕宝库使用一种螺旋布局；另一个会生成无尽宝库。

en: &5But these are usually good ways of finding Wold Star Chunks, which you'll want for high end items.
zh: &5这些通常也是寻找 Wold 星辰碎块的好方法；高端物品会需要它。

en: &5But to start, you'll be very unproficient at it. To increase your skill, you'll need Vault Scrap, which you can get from throwing unused Gear into the Vault Recycler.
zh: &5不过一开始你对此很不熟练。要提高熟练度，需要宝库废料；把不用的装备丢进宝库回收机即可获得。

en: &5But unlike the normal Bingo, when you score a spot, an Event will happen, much like events that happen in Enchanted Elixir.
zh: &5但和普通宾果不同，在你完成一个格子时，会触发一个事件，类似附魔灵药中的事件。

en: &5But you can make a special storage item JUST for Soul Shards, with its own spot in your Curios : The Shard Pouch!
zh: &5不过你可以制作一个专门存灵魂碎片的物品，并且它在 Curios 中有自己的槽位：碎片袋！

en: &5By combining either of these with a Tool in an Anvil, you can add 10 more capacity to the tool.
zh: &5把其中任意一种和工具放入铁砧合成，可以为工具增加 10 点容量。

en: &5By default, you can craft one of three starting Trinket Pouches with it, which give you some combination of the three Trinket colors : Blue, Red, and Green.
zh: &5默认情况下，你可以用它制作三种初始饰品袋之一，分别提供蓝、红、绿三种饰品颜色的不同组合。

en: &5By default, your world or server is set to Normal. If you set it to Casual, you keep your inventory, but your equipment will take a durability hit.
zh: &5默认情况下，世界或服务器为普通模式。如果设为休闲模式，你会保留背包物品，但装备会损失耐久。

en: &5By now you've probably collected a lot of junk or trash from the Vaults.
zh: &5到现在你大概已经从宝库中收集到大量杂物或垃圾了。

en: &5By Researching Junk Management, you gain access to a helpful tool to keeping your backpacks and inventory clear of extra blocks, especially if you use a hammer : The Void Crucible.
zh: &5研究垃圾管理后，你会解锁一个实用工具，用于清理背包和物品栏中的多余方块，尤其适合使用锤子时：虚空坩埚。

en: &5By Sneak + Right Clicking the Altar Recatalyzer on your Altar, it will reroll the items it asks for.
zh: &5按住潜行并将祭坛再催化器右键点击你的祭坛，就会重掷祭坛要求的物品。

en: &5Cake Vaults are unique. The objective is to find as many Cakes as you can. The Rooms in this Vault only have one path : a spiral outward.
zh: &5蛋糕宝库很独特。目标是尽可能找到更多蛋糕。这个宝库中的房间只有一条路线：向外螺旋延伸。

en: &5Called a Crystal Workbench. The Black Chromatic Steel is expensive, but Pillaging those Braziers can net ya an early one. It's used to modify the Vault Crystals you make.
zh: &5它叫水晶工作台。黑色彩钢很贵，但掠夺火盆有机会让你早早拿到一个。它用于修改你制作的宝库水晶。

en: &5Card Juice can be used to upgrade more useful cards by using the Card Upgrade Station.
zh: &5卡牌精华可在卡牌升级站中用于升级更有用的卡牌。

en: &5Cards and Card Decks are a new mechanic that starts at level 50. When you open a card pack, you get a couple cards to choose from.
zh: &5卡牌和牌组是从 50 级开始出现的新机制。打开卡包时，你会得到几张卡牌供你选择。

en: &5Cards can have special restrictions such as "only one Temporal card" or "for each diagonal Red card".
zh: &5卡牌可能带有特殊限制，例如“只能放一张时序卡牌”或“每有一张斜向红色卡牌”。

en: &5Catalyst fragments can be combined, and then brought into a Catalyst Infusion Table and turned into something useful.
zh: &5催化剂碎片可以合成，并带到催化剂灌注台中转化为有用的东西。

en: &5Cavaet being, you know, completing the Vault in the first place.
zh: &5前提当然是，你得先完成这个宝库。

en: &5Challenge rooms like the X-Marks and the Raid Room don't use those spawners, either.
zh: &5X 标记和突袭房间这样的挑战房间也不使用那些刷怪笼。

en: &5Choose a line you think you have a good chance of completing. But be ready to shift gears if you get lucky...
zh: &5选择一条你认为有较大机会完成的线。但如果运气变化，也要准备随时调整目标……

en: &5Coin piles contain, well, what it says on the tin : coins!
zh: &5金币堆里装的东西就和名字一样：金币！

en: &5Collect these when you can. You can Right Click it onto a Bounty Table to take on a special Legendary Bounty, with much better rewards than a normal bounty.
zh: &5看到就尽量收集。你可以把它右键用在悬赏台上，接取一种特殊传奇悬赏，奖励比普通悬赏好得多。

en: &5Combine a Repair Core with the piece of equipment in an Anvil to repair it. It will consume a Repair slot on the equipment and refill the Durability.
zh: &5在铁砧中将修复核心与装备合成即可修复。它会消耗装备的一个修复槽，并补满耐久。

en: &5Combine this with your Vault Tool using an Anvil, and you keep all the Tool abilities it had, but it ALSO cycles through all the visual styles!
zh: &5在铁砧中把它与宝库工具合成，工具会保留原有全部能力，同时循环显示所有视觉样式！

en: &5Companions also have Hearts. If you die in a Vault, your equipped Companion will lose a Heart as well. When a Companion has no hearts left, it will retire and can no longer help in a Vault.
zh: &5伙伴也有爱心。如果你在宝库中死亡，已装备的伙伴也会失去一颗心。当伙伴没有剩余爱心时，它会退休，无法再在宝库中帮助你。

en: &5Companions are little creatures you can catch and bring with you into Vaults. They can provide powerful benefits, and level up to become even more powerful.
zh: &5伙伴是可以捕捉并带入宝库的小生物。它们能提供强力收益，并会升级变得更强。

en: &5Companions can equip Companion Relics and Particles, which can be found as loot in Vault Chests and Treasure Sand.
zh: &5伙伴可以装备伙伴遗物和粒子，这些可作为宝库箱子和宝藏沙中的战利品找到。

en: &5Companions start out rolling a Temporal Modifier, a powerful ability that you can activate once per Vault (Check your keybinds, it may not be set!). This ability levels up and becomes stronger as the Companion levels up!
zh: &5伙伴一开始会随机获得一个时序修饰词，这是一种每个宝库可主动使用一次的强力能力（检查按键绑定，它可能尚未设置！）。该能力会随着伙伴升级而升级并变强！

en: &5Companions, when hatched, roll a Temporal Modifier. And sometimes, you don't want that Modifier, or you already have multiple companions with it!
zh: &5伙伴孵化出来时会随机获得一个时序修饰词。有时候你并不想要那个修饰词，或者已经有多个伙伴拥有它！

en: &5Complete the Artifact, using the Artifact Tome, and then activate the Tome to receive the Herald's Vault Rock.
zh: &5使用神器典籍完成神器，然后激活典籍以获得先驱者的宝库岩。

en: &5Complete the Vault Crystal and enter the Herald's Vault. Don't worry, if you die you won't lose any items.
zh: &5完成宝库水晶并进入先驱者宝库。别担心，死亡不会丢失任何物品。

en: &5Corrupted Objective is a very difficult objective, be warned as the longer you are in the Vault, the more difficult it will become. I shall not say more than to warn you of this, it must be experienced first hand.
zh: &5腐化目标非常困难，请注意，你在宝库里待得越久，它就会变得越难。我不会多说，只提醒你必须亲自体验。

en: &5Death in a PVP Vault will return your inventory to its state before entering it.
zh: &5在 PVP 宝库中死亡，会把你的背包恢复到进入前的状态。

en: &5Defeating the Herald unlocks a recipe in the Vault Forge for a Zephyr Charm.
zh: &5击败先驱者会在宝库锻炉中解锁西风护符配方。

en: &5Dieing in a Vault is handled differently depending on what Vault Mode the server/world is set on.
zh: &5在宝库中死亡会根据服务器或世界设置的宝库模式采用不同处理方式。

en: &5Doing things like killing certain types of monsters in Vaults, or looting an amount of a specific item.
zh: &5例如在宝库中击杀特定类型怪物，或搜刮一定数量的指定物品。

en: &5Don't think too hard about it. It's tasty, tasty candy.
zh: &5别想太多。它就是好吃，好吃的糖。

en: &5Dotted around the Vaults you can occasionally find these large floating crystals called Pylons.
zh: &5宝库中偶尔会散布一些大型漂浮水晶，叫做晶塔。

en: &5Dungeon doors can spawn in the walls of Vault Rooms, usually on the bottom floor. They will have the symbol of a specific monster type on them.
zh: &5地牢门会生成在宝库房间的墙上，通常位于底层。门上会带有特定怪物类型的符号。

en: &5Each Brazier will give you one good and one bad modifier to the Vault when you light it. Usually. Sometimes its only one or the other!
zh: &5每点燃一个火盆，通常都会给本次宝库添加一个正面修饰词和一个负面修饰词。有时也可能只有其中一种！

en: &5Each completed Vault makes the next ones harder, just to warn you. Completing a Challenge Vault gets you the Challenge Vault Rock back, the counter on it ticked up.
zh: &5先提醒你，每完成一个宝库，后续宝库都会更难。完成挑战宝库后，你会拿回挑战宝库岩，它上面的计数会增加。

en: &5Each deck has a certain number of Sockets, which is what Cores are placed into, by combining the Deck and the Core in an Anvil.
zh: &5每个牌组都有一定数量的插槽，核心就放在这些插槽里，方法是在铁砧中合成牌组和核心。

en: &5Each DIFFERENT type of monster, chest, and ore will have different amounts of Elixir. And it changes every time you enter a new Elixir Rush Vault.
zh: &5不同类型的怪物、宝箱和矿石会提供不同数量的灵药，而且每次进入新的灵药冲刺宝库时都会重新变化。

en: &5Each Dungeon spawns either Coin Piles or special Barrels, which are alternate versions of Chests, that all act like Wooden Chests. But to break them properly requires the proper tool Affinity.
zh: &5每个地牢会生成金币堆或特殊木桶，这些木桶是宝箱的变体，行为类似木制宝箱。但要正确破坏它们，需要合适的工具亲和。

en: &5Each ingredient either adds or subtracts from the completion bar. They also may have a positive or negative modifier attached to them.
zh: &5每种材料都会增加或减少完成条进度。它们也可能附带正面或负面修饰词。

en: &5Each Prefix or Suffix on a piece of gear also rolls a Tier. Higher tiers effect the range that it can roll, with higher tiers being higher (of course).
zh: &5装备上的每个前缀或后缀也会掷出阶级。阶级越高，可掷出的数值范围越高，当然也就越强。

en: &5Each Pylon will give you a specific buff for a short amount of time, which will be listed above the Pylon if you are close enough.
zh: &5每个晶塔都会在短时间内给予特定增益；靠得足够近时，增益名称会显示在晶塔上方。

en: &5Each room has only one Cake, somewhere. As you get closer to it, your vision will change.
zh: &5每个房间某处只有一个蛋糕。你越靠近它，视野变化就越明显。

en: &5Each Skill and Talent lists what every point spent in them will give you, but many have an extra section, or levels with a glitching icon at the start.
zh: &5每个技能和天赋都会列出每一级投入点数后的效果，但其中很多还有额外段落，或者带有闪烁图标的等级。

en: &5Each stamp has a specific drop condition: a tiny chance from a specific mob in a specific theme; or from certain actions.
zh: &5每张邮票都有特定掉落条件：从特定主题中的特定怪物身上以极低概率掉落，或由某些行动获得。

en: &5Each Vault Fruit you consume takes 10% of your max HP.
zh: &5每吃一个宝库水果，都会消耗你 10% 最大生命值。

en: &5Early on, recipes for both Vault Hunters items and Researched items will use basic Vault ingredients. Magic Silk, Vault Diamonds, etc.
zh: &5前期，宝库猎人物品和已研究物品的配方都会使用基础宝库材料，例如魔法丝线、宝库钻石等。

en: &5Early on, working out a build is going to be tough, with so few points. But try a bunch of things out!
zh: &5前期点数很少，想成型一个构筑会比较难。多尝试几种路线吧！

en: &5Enter the Filter Necklace! Using the power of Create's Filter and Attribute Filter, you can instead be more selective on what you want to Void.
zh: &5于是过滤项链登场了！借助机械动力过滤器和属性过滤器的力量，你可以更精确地选择要销毁的内容。

en: &5Enter the Trial Chamber's Vault Rock. It's mostly like a normal Vault Rock you put onto the Vault Altar.
zh: &5这时试炼大厅宝库岩就派上用场了。它基本上和放到宝库祭坛上的普通宝库岩类似。

en: &5Equip the doll on your head Curios slot. Make sure you aren't in a Vault Party with your friend, nor should they enter the Vault either. Then run the Vault. It'll randomly 'copy' some of the loot you collect and store it in itself.
zh: &5把娃娃装备到头部 Curios 槽。确保你没有和朋友处在宝库队伍中，他们也不要进入本次宝库。然后你去跑宝库，它会随机“复制”一部分你收集的战利品并存入自身。

en: &5Even if its one item, these are usually good ways of finding Wold Star Chunks, which you'll want for high end items.
zh: &5即使只有一件物品，这些通常也是寻找 Wold 星辰碎块的好方法；高端物品会需要它。

en: &5Even though they stack up to the max, the better you are at fighting the Vault's monsters, the more inventory they'll fill up.
zh: &5即使它们能堆叠到上限，你越擅长清理宝库怪物，它们就越容易占满背包。

en: &5Eventually the Vaults will become too difficult to complete, and you'll lose the Challenger Vault Rock. But you'll get a thing called Embers depending on how many Vaults you completed.
zh: &5宝库终究会难到无法完成，到那时你会失去挑战者宝库岩。但会根据你完成的宝库数量获得名为余烬的东西。

en: &5Eventually you'll find a piece of equipment that should last you long enough that you wear down the Durability to the breaking point.
zh: &5最终你会找到一件足够耐用、能一直用到耐久接近耗尽的装备。

en: &5Every deck can be customized beyond what cards are placed into, but placing Deck Cores onto them!
zh: &5每个牌组都可以在放入卡牌之外进一步自定义，方式是给它们安装牌组核心！

en: &5Every normal Vault has an "Objective", a goal for you to aim for to get bonus rewards. Some stuff you can only GET by completing a Vault successfully.
zh: &5每个普通宝库都有一个“目标”，完成它可以获得额外奖励。有些物品只能通过成功完成宝库获得。

en: &5Except that there is no loot. Not even Soul Shards or Vault XP. Monsters do spawn though.
zh: &5区别是这里没有战利品，甚至没有灵魂碎片或宝库经验。不过怪物仍然会生成。

en: &5Except the Portal Room! This room only has one entrance, and you'll want to remember where it is!
zh: &5传送门房间是例外！这个房间只有一个入口，所以一定要记住它的位置。

en: &5First things first though, let me go over two major changes to the pack in the next two quests :
zh: &5不过先从最重要的开始，接下来两个任务会介绍整合包里的两项主要改动：

en: &5Foci? Focuses? Can never get that straight. But yeah, while the Wild Focus lets you reroll all Prefixes AND Suffixes, these two will let you reroll one or the other.
zh: &5聚焦器？聚焦焦点？我总是分不清。总之，狂野聚焦器会同时重掷所有前缀和后缀，而这两个可以只重掷其中一种。

en: &5Focus like the Wild Focus, you can reroll different aspects of a gear piece for the cost of some Vault Bronze and Vault Plating.
zh: &5像狂野聚焦器这类聚焦器，可以花费一些宝库铜币和宝库镀层来重掷装备的不同方面。

en: &5For now, failing will only damage your equipment a little bit. After Level 19 though...but we'll cover that later.
zh: &5目前失败只会让装备受到一点耐久损伤。不过 19 级之后就不一样了……这部分后面再讲。

en: &5For these situations, you can use a Companion Temporalizer! Place your Companion in a Companion Home, then Sneak + Right Click the Companion Temporalizer on the Home to reroll the Temporal Modifier.
zh: &5遇到这种情况，可以使用伙伴时序调整器！把伙伴放进伙伴之家，然后潜行 + 右键用伙伴时序调整器点击伙伴之家，以重掷时序修饰词。

en: &5For those very much used to Vanilla combat, like myself, the change can feel jarring and out of place. But I suggest giving the mod a chance through a couple Vaults first.
zh: &5如果你和我一样很习惯原版战斗，这种变化一开始可能有些突兀。但我建议至少跑几次宝库后再决定是否适应。

en: &5Forgetting these specializations isn't as easy as spending a bit of gold to unlearn spent skill points, however. Even if you remove all the skill points spent in a skill, the Specialization will still be selected.
zh: &5遗忘这些专精并不像花一点金币遗忘已投入技能点那样简单。即使移除某个技能的所有技能点，专精仍然会保持选择。

en: &5From it, you can craft many types Vault Gear, at your level or below.
zh: &5你可以在其中制作许多类型的宝库装备，装备等级为你的等级或更低。

en: &5Funny thing, the system considers ANY damage an Attack, which includes damage from Poison fields or standing on a campfire.
zh: &5有趣的是，系统会把任何伤害都视为攻击，包括毒云伤害或站在营火上的伤害。

en: &5Gateway Pearls are a special piece of loot that are only obtainable in Mapped Vaults.
zh: &5门径珍珠是一种特殊战利品，只能在地图宝库中获得。

en: &5Gear found with the Market will also be at your level; and Bounties have their own level as well.
zh: &5市场中找到的装备会按你的等级生成；悬赏也有自己的等级。

en: &5Get all of em, and find a Scavenger Altar (green glowing altar that spawns in most rooms). Right Click each stack to deposit it before the timer runs out.
zh: &5收集齐所有物品后，找到拾荒祭坛（大多数房间都会生成的绿色发光祭坛）。在计时结束前右键提交每一组物品。

en: &5Get yourself set up with a base, whether temporary or permanent or "No seriously I'll move eventually!"
zh: &5先给自己搭个基地吧，临时的、长期的，或者那种“真的真的我以后会搬”的基地都行。

en: &5Getting started in Vault Hunters takes a little bit of work, but you can get into your first Vault in an hour or two!
zh: &5宝库猎人的起步确实需要做些准备，但通常一两个小时内就能进入第一个宝库！

en: &5Given you find a lot of Vault Gear, some of it is bound to be really good, but not fit into your current build.
zh: &5你会找到很多宝库装备，其中有些肯定很强，但不适合当前构筑。

en: &5Gives you another chance but can be bad if you died cause you got trapped by a thousand horde mobs.
zh: &5它会给你第二次机会，但如果你是被成群怪物困住才死的，也可能让情况更糟。

en: &5Giving a look through the Skills and Talents, you can get a good idea of the type of builds you might want to try.
zh: &5浏览技能和天赋时，你可以大致了解自己想尝试哪种构筑。

en: &5Good if you got a bunch of Prefix and Suffixes you want, but some of them rolled low in their ranges.
zh: &5如果你有一堆想保留的前缀和后缀，但其中一些数值偏低，它会很有用。

en: &5Hold the Filter Necklace and Right Click with it to open it up, and you can fit plenty of Filters or Attribute Filters in.
zh: &5手持过滤项链并右键打开它，可以放入大量过滤器或属性过滤器。

en: &5I also recommend getting yourself some Iron or Diamond Armor to start with. But that's up to you!
zh: &5我也建议先准备一些铁甲或钻石甲再出发。当然，最终怎么选还是看你自己！

en: &5I highly recommend you use that first skill point on some way to heal yourself. You DO NOT heal naturally in the Vault. You have to use either a Healing skill, or a special Vault Potion.
zh: &5强烈建议把第一个技能点投入某种治疗手段。宝库内不会自然回血，你必须使用治疗技能，或者使用特殊的宝库药水。

en: &5If you are finding the basic Vault Objectives are too easy, or want to mix them up a bit, then look into the more difficult versions!
zh: &5如果你觉得基础宝库目标太简单，或想换点花样，就看看它们更困难的版本吧！

en: &5If you are finding your Vault Tool could use just a little more room for Jewels on them, then the Resonating Reinforcement and Prismatic Reinforcement are two items that can really help out.
zh: &5如果你觉得宝库工具还需要多一点空间镶嵌珠宝，那么共振强化件和棱彩强化件会非常有帮助。

en: &5If you are finding yourself outpacing your equipment a bit too fast, you can make a Plunderer's Vault Rock.
zh: &5如果你发现自己升级速度超过了装备成长，可以制作掠夺者宝库岩。

en: &5If you are in a Vault Party, the LAST person to enter the Vault sets the Vault Difficulty to their setting.
zh: &5如果你在宝库队伍中，最后进入宝库的玩家会决定本次宝库使用的难度设置。

en: &5If you are on a Server with other players, you can use this &lSpectator Terminal &r&5to spectate any currently running Vault.
zh: &5如果你在服务器上和其他玩家一起玩，可以使用这个 &l旁观者终端&r&5旁观任意正在运行的宝库。

en: &5If you are on a server working together with others, you can form a Research Party though.
zh: &5如果你在服务器上与其他玩家合作，可以组建研究队伍。

en: &5If you are on a Skyvault world, you already know what this is. But its also available to normal world gens!
zh: &5如果你在玩天空宝库世界，那你应该已经很熟悉它了。不过普通世界生成也能使用它。

en: &5If you are on the hunt for Vault Scrap more than you are new Vault Gear, then the Blacksmith's Capstone is your friend.
zh: &5如果你更想获得宝库废料，而不是新的宝库装备，那么铁匠顶石就是你的好帮手。

en: &5If you are playing on a server and are grouping up with friends, you can use the Knowledge Brew to share what Research you have unlocked.
zh: &5如果你在服务器上和朋友组队游玩，可以使用知识酿剂分享你已经解锁的研究。

en: &5If you are playing on a server and have a friend joining your game late, you can use the &lMentor's Brew &r&5to bring them up to your level.
zh: &5如果你在服务器上玩，有朋友较晚加入，可以使用 &l导师酿剂&r&5把他们提升到你的等级。

en: &5If you are playing on a Server and want a bit of competition between yourself and other Players, you can use the &lVault PVP Rock.
zh: &5如果你在服务器上游玩，并想和其他玩家来点竞争，可以使用 &l宝库 PVP 岩&r&5。

en: &5If you are playing on a server with friends, you can group up to tackle Vaults together.
zh: &5如果你和朋友在服务器上游玩，可以组队一起挑战宝库。

en: &5If you are sick and tired of finding so many trapped chests, but don't have enough Jewels to slap Trap Disarm on your Vault Tool, then the Avarice Capstone may be helpful to you.
zh: &5如果你受够了大量陷阱宝箱，但又没有足够珠宝给宝库工具装上陷阱拆除，那么贪婪顶石可能会帮上忙。

en: &5If you are wanting a tougher challenge and better rewards, then you can apply a Sigil to your Vault Crystal.
zh: &5如果你想要更艰难的挑战和更好的奖励，可以把徽记应用到宝库水晶上。

en: &5If you are wanting to try the true Battle Royale experience on a server with other Players, you can use the &lPVP Royale Rock.
zh: &5如果你想在有其他玩家的服务器上体验真正的大逃杀，可以使用 &lPVP 大逃杀宝库岩。

en: &5If you don't get enough in time, you'll want to leave via the Portal before the time runs out.
zh: &5如果时间内收集不够，就需要在倒计时结束前通过传送门离开。

en: &5If you don't have enough Vault Gold, you can still retrieve your items, but you will go into debt with The Locker.
zh: &5如果宝库金币不足，你仍然可以取回物品，但会欠下储物柜债务。

en: &5If you get a Treasure Room with THREE Pedestals, you can only take one of them, so choose carefully!
zh: &5如果宝藏房里有三个基座，你只能拿其中一个，所以谨慎选择！

en: &5If you have some friends with you, but you aren't all able to run Vaults at the same rate, you might want to look into &lVault Dolls.
zh: &5如果你和朋友一起玩，但大家跑宝库的频率不同，可以看看 &l宝库娃娃&r&5。

en: &5If you haven't already, head on in. Every Vault is sectioned off into a grid of large Rooms, all connected with hallways in each cardinal direction.
zh: &5如果还没进去，现在就出发吧。每个宝库都由大型房间网格构成，房间之间通过东南西北方向的走廊相连。

en: &5If you haven't Researched any Mods, the Mod Box will drop Knowledge Shards, to get you closer to Researching a mod. Once you've Researched certain mods, the Mod Box only drops certain items from those Mods.
zh: &5如果你还没有研究任何模组，模组盒会掉落知识碎片，让你更接近研究模组。研究特定模组后，模组盒只会掉落那些模组中的特定物品。

en: &5If you look at your Vault Tools, they have a Capacity. You put Jewels on with this Jewel Applicator by putting the Tool and all the Jewels in.
zh: &5查看宝库工具时会看到容量。把工具和所有珠宝一起放入珠宝应用台，就能把珠宝装到工具上。

en: &5If you lose, the chosen modifier becomes weaker or is removed, and the Gear becomes Corrupted.
zh: &5如果失败，所选修饰词会变弱或被移除，装备会变为已腐化。

en: &5If you regularly run Vaults with other players, you might notice that the XP you earn between yourselves can be pretty different between party members. The Vault XP you get depends on your own actions: looting chests, killing mobs, doing tasks, etc. Some players and builds can go much faster and thus get more XP.
zh: &5如果你经常和别人一起跑宝库，会发现队员之间获得的经验可能差很多。宝库经验取决于你的行动：开箱、击杀怪物、完成任务等。有些玩家或构筑推进更快，因此经验也更多。

en: &5If you see this Chaotic Vault Rock for sale in a Vendoor or the Black Market, I highly recommend picking it up!
zh: &5如果在商贩门或黑市看到混沌宝库岩出售，我强烈建议买下来！

en: &5If you still have a piece of Gear you want to use longer when the Durability runs out, you'll want a Repair Core.
zh: &5如果耐久耗尽时，你仍想继续使用某件装备，就需要修复核心。

en: &5If you succeed you will get some special rewards, some you can only find from a Gateway Pearl.
zh: &5成功后你会获得一些特殊奖励，其中有些只能通过门径珍珠获得。

en: &5If you want an alternate way to obtain Vault Altar resources, you can either craft or find a &lBudding Crystal &r&5underground in the Overworld!
zh: &5如果你想用另一种方式获取宝库祭坛材料，可以在主世界地下制作或找到一个 &l生长水晶&r&5！

en: &5If you want to change how fast the crystal costs scale, or even remove the crystal cost, you can set the level for the entire server :
zh: &5如果想调整水晶成本上涨速度，甚至移除成本，可以为整个服务器设置水晶成本模式：

en: &5If you want to play around with different builds, the &lSkill Altar &l&5is a must.
zh: &5如果想尝试不同构筑，&l技能祭坛&r&5几乎是必备品。

en: &5If you win, the modifier you chose becomes stronger and the Gear becomes Imbued!
zh: &5如果成功，你选择的修饰词会变得更强，装备会变为已灌注！

en: &5If you've been following the built-in Vault Hunter's quests, you should of been given your first pieces of Vault Gear!
zh: &5如果你一直跟着内置的宝库猎人任务走，现在应该已经拿到第一批宝库装备了！

en: &5If you've died in a Vault after hitting level 20, no doubt you've found most of your inventory missing and a ghost body spawning where you respawned as well.
zh: &5如果你在 20 级后死于宝库，应该已经发现大部分背包物品消失，并且重生位置出现了一具幽灵躯体。

en: &5If your piece of gear has an empty Prefix or Suffix slot or two, you can use an Amplifying Focus to add something to one of those slots.
zh: &5如果你的装备有一两个空的前缀或后缀槽位，可以用增幅聚焦器向其中一个槽位添加词缀。

en: &5Implicits are the base stats of a piece. Armor always has Armor, Weapons always have Damage in their list of implicits. Some Implicit slots can be a number of things, like Block OR Thorns on shields, but usually never both at the same time... at least as an Implicit.
zh: &5固有词缀是装备的基础属性。护甲总会有护甲，武器总会有伤害。有些固有槽可能是多种属性之一，比如盾牌上的格挡或荆棘，但通常不会同时出现，至少不会作为固有词缀同时出现。

en: &5In return, the kind of loot you can get both from Pillaging braziers and in the completion crate is better.
zh: &5作为回报，无论是掠夺火盆还是完成宝箱，能获得的战利品都会更好。

en: &5In the Entrance, you'll find an NPC called Tommy. This NPC will offer you 3 Skill loadouts, randomly chosen from over a couple dozen. Any skill points not used with the loadouts can be used with Skill Scrolls. You can also go in 'skillless', but this is VERY difficult!
zh: &5在入口处，你会找到名叫 Tommy 的 NPC。这个 NPC 会提供 3 套技能配置，从二十多种配置中随机选择。配置未使用的技能点可用技能卷轴继续分配。你也可以“无技能”进入，但这非常困难！

en: &5In the larger Dungeons in Vaults, you have a chance of finding an Alchemy Archive.
zh: &5在宝库的大型地牢中，你有机会找到炼金档案。

en: &5In the upper right corner, you'll see a small minimap, which will fill out as you enter more rooms. This is the Vault Mapper, which will help track your path through the Vault.
zh: &5右上角会有一个小地图，随着你进入更多房间而逐渐填充。这是宝库地图器，可以帮助你记录在宝库中的路线。

en: &5In the Void Crucible UI, in the top tab, you can look through the different themes and select blocks to blacklist and disable voiding on.
zh: &5在虚空坩埚界面的顶部标签页，可以浏览不同主题，并选择要加入黑名单、禁止销毁的方块。

en: &5In Vault Hunters, enchanting is much easier and straight forward.
zh: &5在宝库猎人中，附魔要简单直接得多。

en: &5In Wold's Vaults, Trinkets require you to wear a Trinket Pouch to equip them.
zh: &5在 Wold 的宝库中，装备饰品需要穿戴饰品袋。

en: &5Infused Catalysts can be applied to your Vault Crystal (in the Crystal Workbench, of course), and can increase the amount of chests you get, or coins, or other useful things.
zh: &5灌注催化剂可以应用到宝库水晶上（当然是在水晶工作台里），并增加宝箱、金币或其他有用内容的数量。

en: &5Inscription Boxes can also be found that give you a random Inscription.
zh: &5你也可以找到铭文箱，它会给你一个随机铭文。

en: &5Inscriptions can be added to your Vault Crystal (using a Crystal Workbench). If it isn't a Common Room, this will guarantee the room on the Inscription spawns in that Vault.
zh: &5铭文可以添加到宝库水晶上（使用水晶工作台）。如果不是普通房间，它会保证该铭文对应的房间在本次宝库中生成。

en: &5Inside Dungeons in Vaults, you have a small chance of finding a Modifier Archive
zh: &5在宝库地牢中，你有小几率找到修饰词档案。

en: &5Inside the Vault, usually in Gilded Chests, you can find Jewel Pouches.  These contain a random Jewel with special modifiers on it (We'll go over that next). You can take the Jewels you don't want and put them in a Vault Recycler for a chance at a Gemstone.
zh: &5在宝库中，通常可以从镀金宝箱找到珠宝袋。里面会有带特殊修饰词的随机珠宝（下一步会详细说）。不需要的珠宝可以放入宝库回收机，有机会得到宝石。

en: &5Inside the Vaults, you can change how strong or weak the various mobs are. This changes their health and the damage they do to you.
zh: &5在宝库中，你可以调整各种怪物的强弱，这会改变它们的生命值以及对你造成的伤害。

en: &5Inside these Vaults, you'll find swarms of monsters to fight, Vault Gear to equip, resources to craft with, and more. Level up, learn skills and talents, create a build around your preferred play style.
zh: &5在宝库里，你会遇到成群怪物、可穿戴的宝库装备、用于制作的资源以及更多内容。升级、学习技能和天赋，并围绕自己喜欢的玩法构筑角色。

en: &5Instead of finding Vault Gear in Ornate and other chests, this Capstone will instead turn the gear into the Recycled result!
zh: &5使用此顶石后，你不会在华丽箱等箱子中找到宝库装备，而是会把那些装备转化为回收结果！

en: &5Instead you must craft a Choice Flask that matches the base skill of the specialization you want to unlearn.
zh: &5你必须制作一个与要遗忘专精的基础技能相匹配的选择烧瓶。

en: &5Instead, you can make Vault Vials, Potions, or Brews. These have limited uses, but can regain uses on them one of three ways :
zh: &5你可以制作宝库药瓶、药水或酿剂来替代普通药水。它们使用次数有限，但可以通过三种方式恢复次数：

en: &5It also boosts the loot you can find. A bit more loot in the chests, and a bigger percentage of Vault Ores being in Mining POIs and rooms.
zh: &5它也会提升可找到的战利品。宝箱内战利品会更多，采矿兴趣点和房间中的宝库矿石比例也会更高。

en: &5It contains a variety of excellent loot. Powerful resources, including Wold Chunks, which you'll need for end-game items.
zh: &5里面包含各种优秀战利品。强力资源，包括终局物品会需要的 Wold 块。

en: &5It doesn't replace your normal bounty either. You can click the BIG bounty icon to read what your current Lost Bounty is.
zh: &5它也不会替代你的普通悬赏。你可以点击那个大大的悬赏图标，查看当前遗失悬赏内容。

en: &5It lets you save your Skill and Talents chosen and recall them later, for much less cost of Vault Gold.
zh: &5它可以保存你选择的技能和天赋，并在之后以更低的宝库金币成本重新调用。

en: &5It may be tempting to eat a bunch of Vault Burgers, yeh? I recommend resisting, level 50 is when things start to slow down even more.
zh: &5吃一堆宝库汉堡可能很诱人，对吧？我建议忍住，50 级开始升级会更慢。

en: &5It sells equipment, resources, and other such things. But only three items are available to purchase at first...
zh: &5它会出售装备、资源和其他物品。不过一开始只有三个物品栏位可购买……

en: &5It takes less Crafting Potential to use these, versus using a Wild Focus to reroll the entire thing.
zh: &5使用这些聚焦器消耗的制作潜力，比用狂野聚焦器重掷整件装备要少。

en: &5It used to just be Vault Diamonds and Jewels, but luxury loot now includes Vault Plushies and Vault Sacks, but only after level 50.
zh: &5过去奢华战利品主要是宝库钻石和珠宝；现在还包括宝库玩偶和宝库袋，但要 50 级后才会出现。

en: &5It will also either add, or replace, one of the modifiers with a special modifier. The pool of modifiers includes + skill modifiers, as well as unique affixes.
zh: &5它还会添加或替换一个特殊修饰词。修饰词池包含 +技能修饰词，以及独特词缀。

en: &5It'll display the creature above the Animatrix. Basically a hologram. Not super useful, like I said, but nice decoratively.
zh: &5它会在动画矩阵上方显示该生物，基本上就是全息投影。像我说的，不算特别实用，但装饰效果不错。

en: &5It's called the Omega Box. It's in the Dungeon Pedestal pools, and the completion crates for special Vault Objectives you'll learn about shortly. Occasionally it'll show up in Bounties and the Market as well.
zh: &5它叫欧米伽盒。它存在于地牢基座战利品池，以及你很快会学到的特殊宝库目标完成宝箱中。偶尔也会出现在悬赏和市场里。

en: &5It's called the Peaceful Capstone. Putting it on a Vault Crystal will remove all the mob spawners in that Vault.
zh: &5它叫和平顶石。把它放到宝库水晶上会移除该宝库中的所有刷怪笼。

en: &5It's fairly expensive, but given how hard it is to get the perfect piece of gear...
zh: &5它相当昂贵，但考虑到获得完美装备有多困难……

en: &5It's important to note : Resources you gain from cards are only obtained IF you get the Completion Crate!
zh: &5有一点很重要：卡牌给予的资源只有在你拿到完成宝箱时才会结算！

en: &5It's just like the Nether Portal. A 4 wide, 5 tall frame of Vault Cobblestone. Or Vault Stone. Or Polished Vault Stone. You can make the portal looking nice.
zh: &5它的形式和下界传送门类似：用宝库圆石、宝库岩或磨制宝库岩搭一个 4 格宽、5 格高的框架。想做得好看一点也完全可以。

en: &5Just be careful! It's very easy to throw yourself into a dangerous situation. Like Lava.
zh: &5只是要小心！你很容易把自己冲进危险处境，比如熔岩。

en: &5Just be sure you bring plenty of Vault coins. Though many of the Vendoor rooms have some neat things to find without purchasing anything.
zh: &5记得带足宝库金币。不过许多商贩门房间即使不买东西，也有些不错内容可找。

en: &5Just combine the two in an Anvil. Helps get a bit more use out of your best equipment.
zh: &5只要把两者放入铁砧合成即可。能让你最好的装备多用一段时间。

en: &5Just insert some Card Juice, an upgradeable card you want to upgrade, and if you have enough Juice it'll power up the card!
zh: &5只要放入一些卡牌精华、一张可升级且你想升级的卡牌，如果精华足够，它就会强化这张卡！

en: &5Just keep this somewhere in your base, and when you have an inventory full of Unidentified Gear, you can Right Click that stand to auto identify all of them at once.
zh: &5把它放在基地里。当你装满一背包未鉴定装备时，右键鉴定台即可一次性自动鉴定全部装备。

en: &5Just know that the basic Soul Diffusor is not very fast. There are...upgrades, but those are much more expensive...
zh: &5不过要知道，基础灵魂扩散器并不快。它有……升级件，但那些要贵得多……

en: &5Keep an eye out for these little blue boxes. They are called Mod Boxes, and they contain, well...
zh: &5留意这些小蓝盒子。它们叫模组盒，里面装着，嗯……

en: &5Keep an eye out in Gilded Chests. See these little chunks of Keys you can find?
zh: &5留意镀金宝箱。看到这些可以找到的小钥匙碎块了吗？

en: &5Keep in mind, this does not include special transmogs, such as those unlocked for God Reputation, special unlock conditions, etc.
zh: &5请记住，这不包括特殊幻化，例如通过神明声望、特殊解锁条件等获得的幻化。

en: &5Keep on the lookout for one of these special Vault Rocks. It's for making a special vault called a Cake Vault.
zh: &5留意这种特殊宝库岩。它用于制作一种特殊宝库：蛋糕宝库。

en: &5Keep your eye out for a fairly rare piece of loot called an Etched Vault Layout.
zh: &5留意一种相当稀有的战利品，叫蚀刻宝库布局。

en: &5Keeping track of all your cards and building a deck with them can be quite daunting, which is where the Card Binder comes in handy!
zh: &5记录所有卡牌并用它们构筑牌组可能相当吓人，这时卡牌收纳册就很有用了！

en: &5Later on, you'll be able to find Arcane Essence, which let you craft Expertise Orbs, which give you bonus Expertise Points.
zh: &5之后你能找到奥术精华，用来制作专精宝珠，从而获得额外专精点。

en: &5Level 50 brings you a wide variety of new Objectives, including the newest one : Alchemy Vaults.
zh: &550 级会带来大量新目标，包括最新的一种：炼金宝库。

en: &5Like Endergized for Magnets, or Channeling for Tridents.
zh: &5例如磁铁的末影充能，或三叉戟的引雷。

en: &5Like it says on the tin. Zombies, Endermen, etc Spawn Eggs will drop out of these.
zh: &5就像名字说的那样，僵尸、末影人等刷怪蛋会从这些蛋里掉出来。

en: &5Like the normal PVP Rock, the second person to enter will start a 2 minute timer, then everyone will be scattered around the Vault. So choosing your Loadout in time is important!
zh: &5和普通 PVP 宝库岩一样，第二个人进入后会启动 2 分钟计时器，随后所有人会被分散到宝库各处。因此及时选择配置非常重要！

en: &5Living Chests regularly contain the ingredients for Vault Burgers.
zh: &5生命宝箱经常包含制作宝库汉堡的原料。

en: &5Living Chests tend to contain a variety of things related to knowledge and research.
zh: &5生命宝箱通常包含各种与知识和研究相关的物品。

en: &5Living, Ornate, and Gilded are 'sliced'. Each slice tosses out one item. But you can just hold the button down and 'slice n dice' quickly.
zh: &5生命、华丽和镀金宝箱则是被“切开”。每切一次会弹出一个物品。你可以按住按钮快速连续切开。

en: &5Looks like you're about to hit level 10. That should open up a new Objective in the Vaults.
zh: &5看起来你快到 10 级了。这会在宝库中解锁一种新的目标。

en: &5Lots o' treasure in em, you know. Including these Lost Bounties.
zh: &5里面可是有很多宝藏。包括这些遗失悬赏。

en: &5Lots of balancing adjustments and Quality of Life additions.
zh: &5同时还有大量平衡调整和便利性改进。

en: &5Magnets have a mode that can be toggled with a hotkey. By default, you start in Pickup Only mode, which will pick up all items nearby.
zh: &5磁铁有一个可以用热键切换的模式。默认是仅拾取模式，会拾取附近所有物品。

en: &5Make yourself a Vault Drink Machine! And an Empty Glass to hold the drink, of course.
zh: &5给自己做一台宝库饮料机吧！当然还要做一个空玻璃杯来装饮料。

en: &5Makes a neat sound when it pops open. And some items you'll need can only be found in these Completion Crates.
zh: &5打开时声音挺带感。有些你会需要的物品只能从这些完成奖励箱中获得。

en: &5Makes quite a satisfying sound, I have to say. And later on, you'll start finding Jewels with "Dismantling", which gives a chance of extra item dropped with each slice.
zh: &5不得不说，声音相当解压。后期你还会找到带“拆解”的珠宝，使每次切开时有几率额外掉落物品。

en: &5Making a Companion Home gives you a place to put your Companion, and also see its stats and change its equipment!
zh: &5制作伙伴之家后，你就有地方安置伙伴，还能查看它的属性并更换装备！

en: &5Many mods are locked behind Research. These mods range from small, singular purpose mods; to big, wide ranging ones.
zh: &5许多模组被研究系统锁定。这些模组有的只是小型单用途模组，有的则规模很大、功能广泛。

en: &5Many new mods to play with, both available from the start and ones you can unlock via Research.
zh: &5这里有许多新模组可供游玩，有些开局即可使用，有些需要通过研究解锁。

en: &5Many of the really good potion abilities can only be found inside Vaults. But those won't be available to find until at least level 20.
zh: &5许多非常强力的药水能力只能在宝库内找到，而且至少要到 20 级后才会开始出现。

en: &5Many skills have specializations you can select. Nova has Toxic or Frost Nova, Earthquake has Landmine, etc.
zh: &5许多技能可以选择专精。例如新星有剧毒新星或冰霜新星，地震有地雷等。

en: &5Mapped Vaults will be more difficult than your standard Vaults. New themes, new mobs, new loot you can ONLY find in Mapped Vaults!
zh: &5地图宝库会比标准宝库更困难。新主题、新怪物、新战利品，且有些只能在地图宝库中找到！

en: &5Meaning, the more you loot from Vaults, the more souls you can get to use in the Black Market.
zh: &5也就是说，你从宝库中搜刮得越多，就能得到越多可用于黑市的灵魂。

en: &5Might be a bit early, but if you start finding yourself with an excess of Vault Rocks, you can always turn them into Vault Rock Candy.
zh: &5也许现在还早，但如果你开始发现宝库岩太多，可以随时把它们做成宝库岩糖。

en: &5Might be a phase I'm forgetting... but the faster you beat the Herald, the better Trophy you get.
zh: &5也许还有一个我忘了的阶段……但你越快击败先驱者，得到的奖杯就越好。

en: &5Monsters will spawn in waves, and to win you must kill every monster within a time limit.
zh: &5怪物会按波次生成，你必须在限时内击杀所有怪物才能获胜。

en: &5More end game goals, including the ability to craft Creative level items. And then there's the post-Herald content, a bigger and bigger challenge...
zh: &5终局目标也更多了，包括制作创造级物品。击败先驱之后还有后续内容，挑战会越来越大……

en: &5Most mods must be unlocked via the Research System. If you don't have the Research, you cannot craft and sometimes can't even use items from a locked mod.
zh: &5大多数模组都必须通过研究系统解锁。如果没有对应研究，你不能制作该模组物品，有时甚至无法使用被锁定模组的物品。

en: &5Most outside healing is disabled in the Vaults, and either doesn't work or causes something to happen.
zh: &5大多数外部治疗在宝库中会被禁用，要么不起作用，要么会引发某些效果。

en: &5Much like Scavenger, the crate is decent. Even better if you get multiple lines!
zh: &5和拾荒类似，奖励宝箱还不错。若能完成多条连线会更好！

en: &5My name is Caigan, and I'm here to guide you through playing this modpack! Whether you are new to Wold's Vaults, or to Vault Hunters at all, these quests are to help guide you through everything.
zh: &5我是 Caigan，会在这里带你熟悉这个整合包。无论你是刚接触 Wold 的宝库，还是第一次玩宝库猎人，这些任务都会一步步带你了解主要内容。

en: &5Mystery Eggs are a good find if you are having trouble locating certain animals to farm for Vault Crystal costs.
zh: &5如果你很难找到某些用于宝库水晶材料的可养殖动物，神秘蛋会很有帮助。

en: &5Next is Reputation. You see, when you complete a God Altar's challenge, you get a buff and sometimes a reward. And a chance at a Reputation point with that God.
zh: &5接着是声望。完成神明祭坛挑战后，你会获得一个增益，有时还有奖励，并有机会获得该神的 1 点声望。

en: &5Nor is always having to dig into your backpack to grab dropped items.
zh: &5总是要翻背包去捡掉落物，也同样烦人。

en: &5Normally in Vanilla Minecraft, you would craft by using either an Enchanting Table, or by applying Enchanted Books.
zh: &5在原版 Minecraft 中，附魔通常要用附魔台，或者把附魔书应用到物品上。

en: &5Normally, Vault Plushies don't start appearing until level 50, but you might be able to find an early one.
zh: &5通常宝库玩偶要到 50 级后才会出现，但你也可能提前找到一个。

en: &5Not just a simple Compass that points to the Vault Portal anymore, the Vault Compass is a much more powerful tool. It can point to a variety of things, from special doors to objectives to other things.
zh: &5它不再只是指向宝库传送门的普通指南针，而是强大得多。它可以指向各种目标，从特殊门到宝库目标，再到其他地点。

en: &5Not much else unlocks for you in the Vaults until you hit 40.
zh: &5在达到 40 级之前，宝库里不会再解锁太多其他内容。

en: &5Not permanently(usually...). Your Coin Pouch should stay with you at least, and any Soulbound equipment. Either at your Bed or your World Spawn should be your Ghost Body.
zh: &5通常不是永久失去。你的钱袋至少会保留，灵魂绑定装备也会保留。你的床边或世界出生点会出现一具幽灵躯体。

en: &5Not to mention, it may be hard to pick out what you want from the visual noise.
zh: &5更不用说，在这么多视觉噪声里挑出你想找的东西也可能很难。

en: &5Note that Prestige Powers not only require Prestige Points, but also Knowledge Points to unlock!
zh: &5注意，威望能力不仅需要威望点，还需要知识点才能解锁！

en: &5Note that you can only fit two Resonating Reinforcements on a tool, but the much rarer Prismatic Reinforcement has no maximum.
zh: &5注意，一件工具最多只能放入两个共振强化件，但更稀有的棱彩强化件没有上限。

en: &5Note that you can only get Catalyst Fragments from Vaults that have 2 or less Gilded Catalysts on them.
zh: &5注意，只有带有 2 个或更少镀金催化剂的宝库，才会掉落催化剂碎片。

en: &5Note that you don't get a refund if you already put stuff in!
zh: &5注意，如果你已经放入了一些材料，是不会退款的！

en: &5Note that you have a Stamina bar, which will deplete as you use Parcool moves. Once it recharges, you can use them again.
zh: &5注意你有一条耐力条，使用 Parcool 动作会消耗耐力；耐力恢复后才能继续使用。

en: &5Note this will ONLY work if the player drinking the Mentor's Brew is lower level than the Brew is set to!
zh: &5注意：只有饮用导师酿剂的玩家等级低于酿剂记录等级时，它才会生效！

en: &5Note though : Mods are divided into sections, and unlocking a mod makes that section cost more for the next mod! Choose carefully.
zh: &5注意：模组被分成不同分类。解锁一个模组后，该分类中下一个模组的费用会提高！请谨慎选择。

en: &5Notice that some slots in your Deck have a glowing outline. These are slots that can ONLY hold Arcane cards!
zh: &5注意你的牌组里有些槽位带发光边框。这些槽位只能放入奥术卡牌！

en: &5Now that you are Level 20, a bunch of new things have opened up for you. The first of these is a new Objective type for the vaults : Scavenger.
zh: &5现在你已经 20 级了，许多新内容开始解锁。第一个就是新的宝库目标类型：拾荒。

en: &5Now that you are level 20, you'll start finding Unidentified Artifacts in your Completion Crates.
zh: &5现在你已经 20 级，会开始在完成奖励箱中找到未鉴定神器。

en: &5Now there is a gamerule that can be set much easier than editing a config file. This will stop all players on the server from leveling beyond that point, until you change the gamerule higher.
zh: &5现在可以用游戏规则更方便地设置。它会阻止服务器上所有玩家超过指定等级，直到你把规则调高。

en: &5Now when you Recycle a unique, you get Unique Shards, which can be used in the Vault Forge to craft a random Unique.
zh: &5现在回收独特物品时，会得到独特碎片；这些碎片可以在宝库锻造台中制作随机独特物品。

en: &5Nullite Fragements craft into Nullite Crystals, which are used in a new tier of tools with higher capacity and repairs called Nullite Tools.
zh: &5虚无岩碎片可合成为虚无岩水晶，用于制作一种新的更高容量、更多修复次数的工具：虚无岩工具。

en: &5Nullite is a rare resource that can only be found from Corrupted objective Vaults.
zh: &5虚无岩是一种稀有资源，只能在腐化目标宝库中找到。

en: &5Objectives that require items, such as Scavenger, will drop into your Inventory like normal however.
zh: &5不过，需要物品的目标，例如拾荒，仍会像平常一样掉进你的物品栏。

en: &5Oh, also! If a gear piece adds to a listed ability, you need at LEAST one point in that ability to use it!
zh: &5对了！如果一件装备为某个列出的技能提供加成，你至少需要在那个技能上投入 1 点才能使用该加成！

en: &5Oh, and the Table has a slot to store all your Bounty Pearls. You use these to 'reroll' a bounty you don't want by selecting it, the hitting the circular arrow.
zh: &5另外，悬赏台有一个槽位可以存放所有悬赏珍珠。选择不想要的悬赏后点击圆形箭头，就能消耗珍珠重掷它。

en: &5Oh, be warned, it also halves the experience you get from the Vault. Slows down you leveling a bit and gives you time to upgrade your gear.
zh: &5哦，还要提醒你，它也会让你从宝库获得的经验减半。这会放慢升级速度，让你有时间升级装备。

en: &5OH, in Treasure Rooms...don't forget to dig up ALL the sand as well!
zh: &5哦，在宝藏房里……别忘了把所有宝藏沙也挖掉！

en: &5Oh! Also, keep your eyes open. Some of the Vendor rooms have some hidden loot in them, or some neat blocks to build with.
zh: &5哦，对了，记得睁大眼睛。有些商贩房间藏着战利品，或者有适合拿来建造的漂亮方块。

en: &5Okay, Level 65 is around where the new mechanics stop for the current version of Vanilla VH. Though you already have your hands full with enhanced vaults.
zh: &5好，65 级左右就是当前原版 VH 新机制基本停止增加的阶段。不过强化宝库已经够你忙了。

en: &5Okay, quick primer for you on Vault Gear and their stats.
zh: &5好了，快速介绍一下宝库装备及其属性。

en: &5Okay, you know the goal of the first Vault Objective. Once you've filled that bar, you'll need to find a Lodestone : A purple floating crystal. They don't spawn in every room, so if you see one try to remember where it is!
zh: &5好了，你已经知道第一个宝库目标要做什么了。填满进度条后，需要找到磁石：一种漂浮的紫色水晶。它们不是每个房间都有，所以看到后尽量记住位置！

en: &5On top of CrystalMode, another new gamerule added lets you set the speed of the Scaling of the ingredients for a crystal.
zh: &5除了 CrystalMode 之外，还有一个新游戏规则可以设置水晶材料需求增长速度。

en: &5Once you accept which Vault Gear you want to risk, you'll be presented with up to three options, and the chance of each succeeding.
zh: &5当你确认要冒险使用哪件宝库装备后，会出现最多三个选项，以及每个选项成功的概率。

en: &5Once you cross the arch into the first Hallway, the Vault Timer will start.
zh: &5当你穿过拱门进入第一条走廊后，宝库计时器就会开始。

en: &5Once you have an egg, you'll need a Companion Incubator to hatch it! It can either be an animal, a mob, or another player. You can rename them (and change the player skin) with a Nametag!
zh: &5有蛋之后，你需要伙伴孵化器来孵化它！它可能是一只动物、一个怪物，或另一名玩家。你可以用命名牌给它们改名（并更换玩家皮肤）！

en: &5Once you have your Vault Crystal and a skill, and hopefully a Shulker Box or two or something for loot, it's time to summon the Vault Portal!
zh: &5当你有了宝库水晶、技能，最好还有一两个潜影盒或其他装战利品的容器后，就可以召唤宝库传送门了！

en: &5Once you hit 40, you'll start finding God Altars in the Vaults. You've probably seen these already : they look like giant moai statue heads. Now these will have an Altar to one of the four Vault Gods.
zh: &5达到 40 级后，你会开始在宝库中找到神明祭坛。你可能已经见过它们了：看起来像巨大的摩艾石像头。现在它们会带有四位宝库神之一的祭坛。

en: &5Once you start collecting Trinkets, you'll eventually find ones you have no use for, or duplicates of a trinket you use sparingly.
zh: &5开始收集饰品后，你最终会找到用不上的饰品，或者一些你很少使用的重复饰品。

en: &5Once you've defeated the Herald, you gain access to a brand new piece of Vault Gear : a Vault Map. Vault Maps are the key to a new post-Herald challenge called Mapped Vaults. They can be crafted in the Vault Forge.
zh: &5击败先驱者后，你会获得一种全新的宝库装备：宝库地图。宝库地图是进入先驱者后新挑战“地图宝库”的关键。它们可以在宝库锻炉中制作。

en: &5One phase is a straight up fight. Watch out for AoE attacks!
zh: &5其中一个阶段是直接战斗。小心范围攻击！

en: &5One piece of Vault Gear you might not have yet is the Magnet.
zh: &5你可能还没有拿到的一件宝库装备是磁铁。

en: &5One thing to note is that Vault Tools are able to break Vault Chests. But only if they have the Affinity for it.
zh: &5需要注意的是，宝库工具可以破坏宝库宝箱，但前提是它拥有对应宝箱的亲和。

en: &5One thing you'll start finding in Living Chests, are Inscriptions and Inscription Pieces. Full Inscriptions will either be a basic Common Room, or one of the special Vault Rooms.
zh: &5你会开始在生命宝箱中找到铭文和铭文碎片。完整铭文要么是基础普通房间，要么是某种特殊宝库房间。

en: &5One way to modify Vault Crystals is with Seals. That'll lock in what objective the Vault has.
zh: &5修改宝库水晶的一种方式是使用印记。印记会锁定宝库的目标类型。

en: &5Only things I can suggest is look over your board in the Portal room, before your timer starts.
zh: &5我唯一能建议的是，在计时开始前，先在传送门房间仔细看一遍棋盘。

en: &5Or if you are wanting a specific suffix or prefix to recycle.
zh: &5或者当你只是想要某个特定后缀或前缀来回收时，也可以考虑。

en: &5Originally, there was no real good way to test these builds, other than with Test Dummies or just going into a normal Vault.
zh: &5最初没有什么真正好用的测试方式，只能用训练假人，或者直接进入普通宝库试。

en: &5Ornate Chests usually contain things related to Vault Gear.
zh: &5华丽宝箱通常包含与宝库装备相关的物品。

en: &5Pacifist recharges over time. Slaughterer recharges when you kill enough enemies. And Goblin recharges when you loot enough chests.
zh: &5和平主义者会随时间恢复充能；屠戮者会在你击杀足够敌人后恢复；哥布林会在你搜刮足够宝箱后恢复。

en: &5Parkour is... basically, you go from point a to point b, except instead of going around stuff in your way, you go over it, under it, or through it instead, using it as leverage instead of a speed bump.
zh: &5跑酷大致就是从 A 点到 B 点时，不是绕开障碍，而是翻过、钻过或借力穿过它们，把障碍变成助力。

en: &5Place down the Vault Drink Machine, and Right Click an Empty Glass onto it to get one of a couple different drinks.
zh: &5放下宝库饮料机，然后用空玻璃杯右键点击它，就能获得几种不同饮料之一。

en: &5Plus it's a good idea to gather as much Vault Resources as you can, and get some mods 'researched' and started up
zh: &5另外，尽量多收集宝库资源，并研究一些模组、把它们运行起来，也是个好主意。

en: &5Popping half your base with a super hammer isn't really fun the first time.
zh: &5第一次用超级锤子把半个基地敲没，真的不好玩。

en: &5Prefixes and Suffixes are the various bonus stats a piece of gear has, and are much easier to reroll than Implicits are. They can be anything from extra armor or damage, more mana, better looting, or even special abilities like causing a Poison or Frost nova to happen when you hit an enemy.
zh: &5前缀和后缀是装备上的各种额外属性，比固有词缀更容易重掷。它们可能是额外护甲或伤害、更多法力、更好的搜刮，甚至是命中敌人时触发毒或冰霜新星这类特殊能力。

en: &5Prestige enables you to continue running Vaults, earning XP and loot. When you gain a level above 100, you earn a Prestige Point.
zh: &5威望让你可以继续跑宝库、获取经验和战利品。当你在 100 级以上再次升级时，会获得一个威望点。

en: &5Prestige Points can be used in the new Prestige Power tab in your VH GUI. They are set into tiers, and each power in a tier you unlock requires a power unlocked in a previous tier (Example : to unlock a 3rd Tier3 Power, you must have 3 Tier2 powers and 3 Tier1 Powers unlocked!)
zh: &5威望点可在 VH GUI 的新威望能力分页中使用。它们按阶层划分，解锁某一阶层的每个能力都需要已解锁前一阶层的能力（例如：要解锁第 3 个 3 阶能力，你必须已解锁 3 个 2 阶能力和 3 个 1 阶能力！）

en: &5Previously you could set a level cap for your game or server by editing a config file. This was a good way to limit how fast some players can go, so everyone keeps to similar levels.
zh: &5以前可以通过编辑配置文件为游戏或服务器设置等级上限，用来限制部分玩家冲级过快，让大家等级保持接近。

en: &5Pylons are those little buffing crystals scattered around. The ones that add strength, or vault time, etc.
zh: &5晶塔就是散布在宝库里的那些小型增益水晶，会增加力量、宝库时间等。

en: &5Quite a useful piece of gear for looting, especially. Any items dropped nearby fly right to you to pick up.
zh: &5它对搜刮尤其有用。附近掉落的物品会直接飞向你并被拾取。

en: &5Reach 100% completion bar and exit the vault to Complete it! If you want to push your luck, you can keep brewing potions, and you'll be rewarded with higher Crate tiers! Though note that you can only overfill by the Completion bar by so much before you can't brew any more.
zh: &5达到 100% 完成条并离开宝库即可完成！如果想赌一把，可以继续酿造药剂，你会获得更高阶的宝箱奖励！不过注意，完成条只能过量填充到一定程度，之后就无法继续酿造。

en: &5Really helps you narrow down a piece of gear to work with your build.
zh: &5这能帮助你更精确地把装备调整到适合你的构筑。

en: &5Recipes have a base ingredient in the left slot, and in the middle slot is the ingredient you infuse into it. The bar below this shows how many you need if you hover over it.
zh: &5配方左侧槽位放基础材料，中间槽位放要灌注进去的材料。把鼠标悬停在下方进度条上，可以看到需要的数量。

en: &5Research is simple : Craft Knowledge Stars from the Knowledge Dust you find in Living Chests, and consume them. Then in your Vault Hunters GUI, you can select a mod to Unlock.
zh: &5研究很简单：用生命宝箱中找到的知识尘制作知识星并食用，然后在宝库猎人界面选择要解锁的模组。

en: &5Research mods that you don't have, you are restricted from crafting items from. Sometimes you can't even use the items, like certain machines, from the mod at all until you Research it.
zh: &5未研究的模组会限制你制作其中的物品。有时在研究之前，甚至连某些机器之类的物品都无法使用。

en: &5Right Click a Vault Rock onto the Vault Altar. It'll pop up with four items and how much of each the Vault Altar wants. This is the cost of making a Vault Crystal, which will create a Portal into a Vault.
zh: &5将宝库岩右键放到宝库祭坛上。祭坛会显示四种所需物品以及各自数量，这就是制作宝库水晶的成本，而宝库水晶能打开通往宝库的传送门。

en: &5Right now, Crystals will cost you dirt. Almost literally. The price starts out really cheap, with easy to get materials.
zh: &5现在制作水晶几乎只会花你一点“泥土钱”，差不多是字面意思。起步成本非常低，所需材料也很容易获得。

en: &5Runes'll occasionally spawn in chests, and you'll need at least 5 of them to summon the boss. Each rune will modify the boss's health, damage, and how often they use their abilities; as well as adding a reward.
zh: &5符文会偶尔在宝箱中生成，至少需要 5 个才能召唤首领。每个符文都会改变首领的生命、伤害和技能使用频率，并添加一份奖励。

en: &5Scavenger is probably one of the most difficult objectives, and its Completion Crate is the most...lucrative to match it.
zh: &5拾荒可能是最困难的目标之一，而它的完成奖励箱也相应地非常……丰厚。

en: &5Sealing gear will not replace Frozen modifiers, however.
zh: &5不过封印装备不会替换被冻结的修饰词。

en: &5Second type is Talents. These are passive buffs. More damage with certain abilities, faster mana regeneration, more damage at low health, etc.
zh: &5第二类是天赋，它们提供被动增益，例如强化特定技能伤害、提高法力回复、低生命时增加伤害等。

en: &5See that purple crystal looking thing you just got? Not the Elixir orb, that other thing. That's a Soul Shard.
zh: &5看到刚拿到的那个像紫色水晶的东西了吗？不是灵药光球，是另一个东西。那就是灵魂碎片。

en: &5See those Bounty Pearls you've been finding in Wooden Chests? They're quite useful for creating and using the Bounty Table.
zh: &5看到你在木制宝箱中找到的那些悬赏珍珠了吗？它们对制作和使用悬赏台非常有用。

en: &5See, each Cake you find adds modifiers to the Vault. Usually good and bad. More loot, but tougher enemies.
zh: &5每找到一个蛋糕，都会给宝库添加修饰词。通常有好有坏，例如更多战利品，但敌人更强。

en: &5See, when you 'release' the doll, it starts to run around. To get your loot, you gotta kill it.
zh: &5看，娃娃被“释放”后会开始到处跑。想拿战利品，你得把它杀掉。

en: &5Seems a few recipes still need Soul Shards, so you'll need to grab them out yourself. But things like The Black Market can pull out Shards for you.
zh: &5有些配方似乎仍然需要直接使用灵魂碎片，所以必要时你得自己取出来。不过黑市之类的系统可以直接从袋子里抽取碎片。

en: &5Sigils come in 5 tiers, each tier adding more difficulty to the Vault, but also increasing the Crate tier, which increases the rewards inside it if you complete the Objective.
zh: &5徽记共有 5 个阶级，每个阶级都会提高宝库难度，同时提升奖励箱阶级；如果完成目标，箱内奖励也会增加。

en: &5Since there are lots of different keys, you may want to utilize the Treasure Keyring. You can store all your Treasure Room Keys in this, and use it on Treasure Doors to open them if you have the matching key.
zh: &5由于钥匙种类很多，你可能会想使用宝藏钥匙环。它可以存放所有宝藏房钥匙，并在你拥有匹配钥匙时用于打开宝藏门。

en: &5So a bit of terminology explanation, since it can be a bit confusing. There are three main things to know at the start : Abilities, Talents, and Expertise.
zh: &5先解释几个术语，因为它们一开始可能有点绕。前期主要需要知道三类内容：技能、天赋和专精。

en: &5So a Zombie might give you a lot of Elixir, while a Skeleton gives you little, for example.
zh: &5比如说，僵尸可能会给很多灵药，而骷髅可能只给一点点。

en: &5So all Vault Gear stats are split into three catagories of Affixes : Implicits, Prefixes, and Suffixes. Each Gear piece has a set number of each of these, usually depending on rarity.
zh: &5所有宝库装备属性分为三类词缀：固有词缀、前缀和后缀。每件装备通常会根据稀有度拥有固定数量的这些词缀。

en: &5So I mentioned Jewels you can find in the the Vaults, or more specifically : Jewel Pouches
zh: &5我提到过你可以在宝库中找到珠宝，更准确地说，是珠宝袋。

en: &5So it's important to understand the difference between Affinity and Reputation when it comes to the Gods.
zh: &5谈到宝库神时，理解亲和与声望的区别很重要。

en: &5So now the question becomes : What is Wold's Vaults? Well, this is a spinoff of Vanilla VH, with tons of new features.
zh: &5那么问题就变成了：Wold 的宝库是什么？它是基于原版 VH 的衍生整合包，加入了大量新功能。

en: &5So there's a few things ye can make to help out. The Debagnitizer will stop your Sophisticated Backpacks from auto picking up items in an area.
zh: &5所以有几样东西可以帮忙。背包消磁器会阻止精致背包在一定区域内自动拾取物品。

en: &5So you probably haven't tried it, but I wouldn't suggest taking in normal potions like Potions of Healing or the like.
zh: &5你可能还没试过，但我不建议带普通药水进宝库，比如治疗药水之类。

en: &5So, make one of these four special God items, and put them onto your Vault Altar like any other Vault Rock. Completing the Vault Crystal will get you a special Zealot Vault.
zh: &5制作四种特殊神明物品之一，然后像普通宝库岩一样放到宝库祭坛上。完成宝库水晶后，你会得到一个特殊的狂热者宝库。

en: &5So, sometimes when you start a Vault, you'll see some special modifiers activate. Like the Raw Vaults always have specific modifiers, for example.
zh: &5有时开始宝库时，你会看到一些特殊修饰词生效。比如原始宝库总是带有特定修饰词。

en: &5Some more....focused focuses are going to start showing up in chests for you now.
zh: &5一些更加……专注的聚焦器现在会开始出现在箱子里。

en: &5Some Objectives can only be completed if you exit out of the Portal here. Or, if you can't complete the Objective, you'll need to get out via this Portal to not 'fail' the Vault.
zh: &5有些目标只有从这里的传送门撤离才算完成。或者如果你无法完成目标，也需要从这个传送门离开，才能避免宝库判定为失败。

en: &5Some of the Mods you can Research will require these Spawn Eggs to use them, like Cagerium for example.
zh: &5你研究解锁的一些模组会需要这些刷怪蛋才能使用，例如笼养场。

en: &5Some themes also have unique rooms... like the Pirate Cove.
zh: &5有些主题还会拥有独特房间……比如海盗湾。

en: &5Something you'll start noticing, is as you level above 50, Cards will become more and more common.
zh: &5你会开始注意到，等级超过 50 后，卡牌会越来越常见。

en: &5Sometimes it isn't worth rerolling a piece unless its a higher rarity.
zh: &5有时候如果装备稀有度不够高，并不值得重掷。

en: &5Sometimes the Jewels have more than one ability on them, but all of the Jewels from Pouches will be Size 10, while Jewels from the Jewel Crafting Table can be 5 to 20, depending on what it adds.
zh: &5有时珠宝会带有多个能力。珠宝袋产出的珠宝大小固定为 10，而珠宝制作台制作的珠宝会根据添加内容在 5 到 20 之间变化。

en: &5Sometimes the Vault Altar asks for some... difficult items to make a Crystal. Maybe you are in a Skyvault and don't have that mob egg yet. Maybe the nearest jungle is 10k blocks away.
zh: &5有时宝库祭坛会要求一些很难弄到的物品来制作水晶。也许你在天空宝库里还没有那个刷怪蛋，也许最近的丛林在一万格外。

en: &5Sorta like magic rings or amulets. They give some sort of bonus or power in the Vaults when worn.
zh: &5有点像魔法戒指或护符。装备后会在宝库中给予某种加成或能力。

en: &5Starting at 50, Points of Interest will start generating Strongboxes.
zh: &5从 50 级开始，兴趣点会开始生成保险箱。

en: &5Starting at Level 50, you have a small chance of getting a Companion Egg to spawn as you run normal Vaults.
zh: &5从 50 级开始，跑普通宝库时有小概率生成一个伙伴蛋。

en: &5Starting at level 60, you have a chance of finding Imbuement Altars inside Dungeons. The larger the Dungeon, the higher the chance.
zh: &5从 60 级开始，你有机会在地牢中找到灌注祭坛。地牢越大，出现概率越高。

en: &5Stuff like stone or wood from the POI's you can't do much with, but the stuff inside chests like Wood Chunks can be broken down into a more useful thing : Soul Dust.
zh: &5兴趣点里的石头或木头可能用处不大，但宝箱中的木块之类物品可以分解成更有用的东西：灵魂尘。

en: &5Submitting things is easy too. Just hold the item in your hand and Right Click the Bounty Table.
zh: &5提交物品也很简单。手持物品右键点击悬赏台即可。

en: &5Supposedly there's more loot in these as well, and loot you can only find in Strongboxes.
zh: &5据说里面战利品更多，而且有些战利品只能在保险箱中找到。

en: &5Swords are a good balance of damage, speed, and range. Their sweeping hit strikes multiple enemies at once.
zh: &5剑在伤害、速度和攻击范围之间较为均衡。它的横扫命中可以一次攻击多个敌人。

en: &5Take a Vault Map and a Vault Crystal with Greedy on it, combine them in an Anvil and you are ready to Greed!
zh: &5拿一张宝库地图和一枚带有贪婪的宝库水晶，在铁砧中合成，就准备好去贪婪吧！

en: &5That be a treasure map, yarr! Showing ya to yer plunder, of course.
zh: &5那就是藏宝图，呀哈！当然是指引你找到宝藏。

en: &5That last one isn't as useful unless you got a lot of friends or if your Vault Timer is fairly extended.
zh: &5最后那个布局通常没那么有用，除非你有很多朋友，或你的宝库计时器已经延长了不少。

en: &5That Phoenix Capstone I gave you is an example of one of the things you can add onto a vault crystal.
zh: &5我给你的凤凰顶石就是可以添加到宝库水晶上的一种效果示例。

en: &5That'll add affix slots, but you'll have to reroll to get something in em.
zh: &5这会增加词缀槽，但你必须重掷才能让槽里出现内容。

en: &5That's your spirit, and if you want your inventory back, you'll be wanting to make a Spirit Extractor.
zh: &5那就是你的灵魂。如果想拿回背包，就需要制作灵魂提取器。

en: &5That's...a lot of things to see at once. I'm getting a headache thinking about it. I suggest being careful with this one, since the constant sparkling lights might mess with your eyes.
zh: &5那真是一次要看的东西太多了。光想想我都头疼。这个顶石建议谨慎使用，持续闪烁的光可能会刺激眼睛。

en: &5The Adaptive Focus is a rare Focus you can only obtain by recycling Omega rarity gear. There's a 1 in 4 chance of getting an Adaptive Focus when you scrap one, but can be very powerful.
zh: &5自适应聚焦器是一种稀有聚焦器，只能通过回收欧米伽稀有度装备获得。分解时有 1/4 几率得到自适应聚焦器，效果非常强。

en: &5The Afterlife modifier lets you keep your inventory if you die or fail the Vault, but in return you can't modify it further in a Crystal Workbench.
zh: &5来世修饰词允许你在死亡或宝库失败时保留背包，但作为代价，这个水晶不能再在水晶工作台中进一步修改。

en: &5The All-Seeing Eye Capstone adds the All Seeing Eye modifier to your Vault.
zh: &5全视之眼顶石会为你的宝库添加全视之眼修饰词。

en: &5The Animatrix is a fun little block. Not super useful, but a good deco block.
zh: &5动画矩阵是个有趣的小方块。实用性不算强，但很适合装饰。

en: &5The Black Market is a way for you to obtain items and materials that can help you in the Vaults. The cost? Soul Shards, which it can pull directly from your Soul Pouch.
zh: &5黑市可以让你获得有助于宝库探索的物品和材料。代价是灵魂碎片，而且它可以直接从你的灵魂袋中抽取。

en: &5The bottom tab will show you all the items you have blacklisted, and you can click to remove them.
zh: &5底部标签页会显示所有已加入黑名单的物品，你可以点击移除。

en: &5The Bounty Table is a pretty good way to get some extra resources and gear. It'll ask you to either do something, or submit something to the table for the reward.
zh: &5悬赏台是获取额外资源和装备的好方式。它会要求你完成某件事，或向悬赏台提交某些物品来换取奖励。

en: &5The built-in Vault Hunters quests will give you a Neuralizer. Which lets you reset your Expertise points and reallocate them. They are very expensive, so save it until you really want to re-spec your Expertise.
zh: &5内置宝库猎人任务会给你一个神经重置器，可重置专精点并重新分配。它们非常贵，所以最好留到真正想重配专精时再用。

en: &5The Companion Egg will send a message in your chat when it spawns, where it will either spawn in a room you've already been in, OR in a room you added yourself with an Inscription. Look around, it will be giving off particles, but might be a bit hard to spot at first.
zh: &5伙伴蛋生成时会在聊天中发送消息，它会生成在你已经去过的房间，或由你用铭文加入的房间。仔细找找，它会散发粒子，但一开始可能不太显眼。

en: &5The cost is determined primarily by what items and equipment you entered the Vault with.
zh: &5费用主要由你进入宝库时携带的物品和装备决定。

en: &5The Cryonic Focus will Freeze a random modifier on a piece of gear.
zh: &5寒冻聚焦器会冻结一件装备上的随机修饰词。

en: &5The Deck Station has a variety of basic cores you can craft to add a bonus to your Deck. More advanced cores can be found while Vaulting. Look in places like Dungeons and special Omega rooms for them!
zh: &5牌组站里有多种可制作的基础核心，可为牌组增加加成。更高级的核心可以在跑宝库时找到。去地牢和特殊欧米伽房间这类地方找找！

en: &5The Doll Blender is simple. Set it down, insert Vault Doll, Blend Vault Doll, and the Blender holds the loot so you can retrieve it at a safer pace.
zh: &5娃娃搅拌机很简单：放下它，塞入宝库娃娃，搅拌娃娃，然后搅拌机会保存战利品，让你更安全地慢慢取回。

en: &5The downside is twofold, though : It is very expensive to apply, and it will consume a Repair Slot on the piece of gear.
zh: &5不过缺点有两个：应用费用非常昂贵，而且会消耗这件装备的一个修复槽。

en: &5The Dungeon Capstone can be added to a Vault Crystal in the Crystal Workbench.
zh: &5地牢顶石可以在水晶工作台中添加到宝库水晶上。

en: &5The easiest way to do that is to wear one of the God Charms. There's also an Expertise to help with this.
zh: &5最简单的方法是佩戴对应神明护符。也有一个专精可以帮助你提高亲和。

en: &5The Empowered Chaotic Focus will select a random modifier on the gear and improve it.
zh: &5强化混沌聚焦器会选择装备上的一个随机修饰词并提升它。

en: &5The enhanced version of Bingo is called : Ballistic Bingo.
&5The enhanced version of Elixir Rush is called Enchanted Elixir.
zh: &5灵药狂潮的强化版叫附魔灵药。

en: &5The enhanced version of Light the Braziers is called : Light the Haunted Braziers!
zh: &5点亮火盆的强化版叫：点亮闹鬼火盆！

en: &5The enhanced version of Scavenger Hunt is called : Unhinged Scavenger Hunt!
zh: &5拾荒狩猎的强化版叫：失控拾荒狩猎！

en: &5The Enigma Egg contains special eggs you cannot get anywhere else.
zh: &5谜之蛋包含无法从其他地方获得的特殊蛋。

en: &5The extra attribute could ruin an otherwise perfect tool. Having a Wooden Chestbreaker that slices through stone like butter creates more problems, for example.
zh: &5那个额外属性可能毁掉本来很完美的工具。比如木制破箱器如果能像切黄油一样切穿石头，反而会制造更多麻烦。

en: &5The fight is in multiple phases...and is very tough. Be careful. And don't worry, it takes almost everyone multiple attempts.
zh: &5这场战斗有多个阶段……而且非常困难。小心点。别担心，几乎所有人都要尝试好几次。

en: &5The first difference is that many of the existing Scavenger items will be moved to a different source. Like Ribcages and Skulls? Now they drop from Skeletons only.
zh: &5第一个区别是，许多现有拾荒物品会被移动到不同来源。比如肋骨和头骨？现在只会从骷髅掉落。

en: &5The first four tiers are craftable, but the 5th their can only be found in Treasure Sand.
zh: &5前四个阶级可以制作，但第 5 阶只能在宝藏沙中找到。

en: &5The first room you'll enter is the Portal Room, it lets you prepare, as well as wait for other players to load.
zh: &5你进入的第一个房间是传送门房间，它可以让你做最后准备，也可以等其他玩家加载完成。

en: &5The first thing's you'll be hunting for are Chromatic Iron and Vault Stone.
zh: &5最开始要寻找的是彩铁和宝库岩。

en: &5The flip side of that coin is the Nullifying Focus. It's a bit of a gamble, as you will remove a single Suffix or Prefix and free up the slot.
zh: &5与之相反的是消除聚焦器。它有些看运气，因为会移除一个后缀或前缀，并释放那个槽位。

en: &5The Frenzy Capstone adds a curse called Frenzy to your Vault.
zh: &5狂乱顶石会给你的宝库添加名为狂乱的诅咒。

en: &5The Fundamental Focus rerolls all Implicits, giving you a chance at a higher roll, and some additional abilities.
zh: &5根本聚焦器会重掷所有固有词缀，让你有机会获得更高数值和一些额外能力。

en: &5The Herald is split into multiple phases, one for each Vault God. I highly suggest some movement boosters, and yer best protective Gear.
zh: &5先驱者分为多个阶段，每个宝库神各对应一个阶段。我强烈建议准备一些移动增益，以及你最好的防护装备。

en: &5The higher your Affinity, the bigger chance of gaining Reputation. Note that there's a max amount of Reputation you can have with every Vault God.
zh: &5你的亲和越高，获得声望的几率越大。注意，每位宝库神的声望都有上限。

en: &5The issue with the Void Crucible and Voiding pickup mode, as they are, is that they void all non-Vault blocks, and the blacklist function has a max of 54 blocks to save from Voiding.
zh: &5虚空坩埚和销毁拾取模式的问题在于，它们会销毁所有非宝库方块，而黑名单最多只能保存 54 个需要防止销毁的方块。

en: &5The items vary in price, but slots highlighted in purple are considered a Good Deal almost always.
zh: &5物品价格各不相同，但紫色高亮的栏位几乎总是划算交易。

en: &5The last mode is Off, which disables your Magnet completely.
zh: &5最后一个模式是关闭，会完全禁用你的磁铁。

en: &5The last section of stats for a piece of gear I haven't fully explained are the Implicits.
zh: &5我还没完全解释的装备属性最后一部分，就是固有词缀。

en: &5The Locker will apply to all future Vaults you make until the Debt is paid. You will not gain any experience in Vaults with The Locker.
zh: &5在债务还清之前，储物柜会影响你之后制作的所有宝库。带有储物柜债务的宝库不会获得经验。

en: &5The Merchant Capstone can be added to Vault Crystal to get all Vendoors to highlight while you are in that Vault.
zh: &5商贩顶石可以添加到宝库水晶上，使你在该宝库中看到所有商贩门高亮。

en: &5The Mod Box Workstation is a Researchable tool that enables you to craft Targeted Mod Boxes.
zh: &5模组盒工作站是一种可研究工具，可以让你制作定向模组盒。
