en: &5The Modifier Archive will present you with a bunch of new Modifiers you can put on your Vault Gear with the Modification Table.
zh: &5修饰词档案会给你展示一批新的修饰词，可通过修改台添加到宝库装备上。

en: &5The moment you get into combat, you'll notice the smoother animations, and fairly different feel of it versus normal Minecraft combat.
zh: &5一进入战斗，你就会注意到更流畅的动画，以及和普通 Minecraft 战斗明显不同的手感。

en: &5The neat thing is you can unlock special Transmogs in various ways : researching mods, doing cool things in the Vault, etc.
zh: &5有趣的是，特殊幻化可以通过多种方式解锁：研究模组、在宝库中完成精彩操作等等。

en: &5The Prosperous Capstone can be added to a Vault Crystal to guarantee that the Completion Crate has an Artifact in it.
zh: &5繁荣顶石可以添加到宝库水晶上，保证完成奖励箱中包含一件神器。

en: &5The Pylon Capstone will cause all Pylons to highlight in the Vault.
zh: &5晶塔顶石会让宝库中的所有晶塔高亮显示。

en: &5The rarity of the gear determines how many Prefix and Suffix slots it has. The rarer, the more slots.
zh: &5装备稀有度决定它拥有多少前缀和后缀槽位。越稀有，槽位越多。

en: &5The Recycler is also the only way you can get some resources. And Recycling gear with special affixes (like Chilling, or extra armor, etc) might net you a Faceted Focus you can use on a piece of Vault Gear in your Vault Artisan Station.
zh: &5回收机也是获取某些资源的唯一方式。带有特殊词缀的装备（例如寒冷、额外护甲等）回收后，还可能产出可在宝库工匠台中使用的刻面聚焦器。

en: &5The Royale Vault will roll a random objective to complete. All loot from chests, mobs, etc will go into a Royale Crate in your inventory, which you only get when you complete the Vault. You cannot exit the portal early, so it is either all or nothing.
zh: &5大逃杀宝库会随机生成一个需要完成的目标。来自箱子、怪物等的所有战利品都会进入你背包中的大逃杀宝箱，只有完成宝库后才能获得。你不能提前从传送门离开，所以要么全拿，要么全无。

en: &5The Seal of the Architect is Bingo, but...expanded. The first Architect seal you add to a crystal makes it a 3x3 Bingo grid.
zh: &5建筑师印记就是宾果，不过……扩展了。你给水晶添加的第一个建筑师印记会让它变成 3x3 宾果棋盘。

en: &5The second is why it's called Unhinged. They more than double the number of Scavenger items you can find. Not even a Double Pouch can hold every Unhinged Scavenger item!
zh: &5第二个区别就是它为何叫失控：可找到的拾荒物品数量增加到两倍多。就连双层袋也装不下所有失控拾荒物品！

en: &5The second mode is Pickup + Void. This will pick up all items around you, but delete anything blocks that are registered as part of the Vault's design (dirt, bricks, etc).
zh: &5第二个模式是拾取 + 销毁。它会拾取周围所有物品，但会删除属于宝库装饰结构的方块，例如泥土、砖块等。

en: &5The shape of your Vault Tool depends on which Tool abilities it has. If its just got Picking on it, its a Pickaxe.
zh: &5宝库工具的外形取决于它拥有的工具能力。如果只有挖掘，它就是镐。

en: &5The Spirit Extractor will list how much Vault Gold it costs to get your equipment back. If you don't have enough, you may have the option to get your items back in exchange for going into debt with The Locker. See the Spirit Extractor quest in the next section.
zh: &5灵魂提取器会显示赎回装备需要多少宝库金币。如果金币不够，可能可以通过向储物柜负债来取回物品。下一节的灵魂提取器任务会介绍它。

en: &5The starter Trinket Pouch enables you to equip one Blue and one Red trinket. You can find other Trinket Pouches as loot or other ways, and they can let you equip Green color trinkets, or two of the same color Trinket, or more than 2 Trinkets.
zh: &5初始饰品袋允许你装备一个蓝色饰品和一个红色饰品。其他饰品袋可以作为战利品或通过其他方式获得，并可能允许装备绿色饰品、两个同色饰品，或超过两个饰品。

en: &5The Stylish Focus lets you apply this cycling visual effect to any Vault Tool.
zh: &5时尚聚焦器可以把这种循环外观效果应用到任意宝库工具上。

en: &5The Suspension Focus enables you to freeze specifically a Legendary, Corrupted, Greater, or Unusual modifier.
zh: &5悬停聚焦可以专门冻结一个传奇、腐化、强大或异常修饰词。

en: &5The system doesn't know what to show, so it cycles through ALL of them!
zh: &5系统不知道该显示成什么，于是会在所有外形之间循环！

en: &5The Temporal Shard is consumed when used, but you collect and save Shards between Vaults.
zh: &5时空碎片使用后会被消耗，但你可以在多次宝库之间收集并保存碎片。

en: &5The Treasure Capstone adds a modifier that enables you to see Treasure Doors in that Vault.
zh: &5宝藏顶石会添加一个修饰词，让你在该宝库中看见宝藏门。

en: &5The type of gear determines what kind of Implicits (the set attributes of a piece), and Suffixes and Prefixes (additional attributes) it can have.
zh: &5装备类型决定它可以拥有哪些固有词缀，以及哪些后缀和前缀。固有词缀是固定属性，前后缀是额外属性。

en: &5The Vault Altar asks for a lotta things, and it only asks for even more as you level up.
zh: &5宝库祭坛会要很多东西，而且随着等级提升，它要的东西只会越来越多。

en: &5The Vault Enchanter is your one stop shop for almost any Enchantment. Though they don't come free...
zh: &5宝库附魔台几乎能处理所有附魔，是一站式附魔工具。当然，它们不是免费的……

en: &5The Vault Forge is both handy and quite a hog to get the most out of it.
zh: &5宝库锻造台很方便，但想充分发挥它也很吃资源。

en: &5The Vault Recycler can take Vault Gear, Jewels, and some other vault items and break them down into some resources.
zh: &5宝库回收机可以分解宝库装备、珠宝和其他一些宝库物品，转化为若干资源。

en: &5The Void Crucible lets you choose which blocks to void or keep when you have your magnet in Pickup + Void mode.
zh: &5虚空坩埚允许你在磁铁处于拾取 + 销毁模式时，选择哪些方块要销毁或保留。

en: &5The whole Vault will be themed to that God, and all God Altars you find will be for that God only.
zh: &5整个宝库都会以该神为主题，你找到的所有神明祭坛也只会属于该神。

en: &5The Wild Focus' primary use is to reroll all the Prefix and Suffix slots on a piece of gear.
zh: &5狂野聚焦器的主要用途，是重掷一件装备上的所有前缀和后缀槽位。

en: &5The Wold Star is a late game/end game crafting material that is primarily used to make super powerful items, such as Creative tier items.
zh: &5Wold 星辰是一种后期/终局制作材料，主要用于制作超强物品，例如创造级物品。

en: &5The Wood Chunks and Ornate Bricks and stuff can be used as some nice decor and building material, but using the Soul Diffusor, you can instead use them to create Soul Shards.
zh: &5木块、华丽砖块等可以作为不错的装饰和建筑材料；但使用灵魂扩散器时，也可以把它们转化为灵魂碎片。

en: &5The Zephyr Charm is a powerful charm that boosts your ground speed a bit, but also boosts your air speed by much, much more!
zh: &5西风护符是一件强力护符，会略微提升你的地面速度，但会大幅、大幅提升你的空中速度！

en: &5Themes are how the vault looks and what mobs normally spawn in it; as well, each one has some sort of perk to it. This can be a bonus to loot, or more ore spawning, etc.
zh: &5主题决定宝库的外观和通常生成的怪物；同时每个主题还会带有某种加成，例如增加战利品、生成更多矿石等。

en: &5Then look no further than the Gear Sealer. Take your piece of Gear, place it into the Gear Sealer, add some Ascendant Marks, Gold, and Painite, and hit the button.
zh: &5那就看看装备封印器吧。把装备放入装备封印器，加入一些飞升印记、金币和硅硼钙石，然后按下按钮。

en: &5Then make yourself a Vault Altar and place it down somewhere. When you do, it will bind to you, and only you can place Vault Rocks on it.
zh: &5然后制作一个宝库祭坛并放在合适的位置。放下后它会绑定到你，只有你能把宝库岩放到这个祭坛上。

en: &5Then take your Vault Scrap to the Vault Forge, and put them in the slot in the upper right with the same Scrap shape. It takes more and more scrap per level to keep your proficiency up.
zh: &5把宝库废料带到宝库锻造台，放入右上角同形状的废料槽中。熟练度越高，每级需要的废料越多。

en: &5Then the lootin phase. You need to find the Inhibitors in the Chests and throw em at the floating orbs.
zh: &5接着是搜刮阶段。你需要在箱子里找到抑制器，并把它们扔向漂浮的球体。

en: &5Then there's what I call the Monster Mash phase. Five waves of monsters will spawn, and to get to the next stage you need to kill the mobs in the gray zone that shows up.
zh: &5然后是我称为怪物乱斗的阶段。五波怪物会生成，要进入下一阶段，你需要击杀出现在灰色区域内的怪物。

en: &5Then use the Unboxing Station! You can Right Click or Hopper your Booster Packs and Jewel Pouches into it, and then Right Click it to start opening them one after another.
zh: &5那就使用开包站！你可以右键或用漏斗把补充包和珠宝袋放进去，然后右键它开始连续开启。

en: &5Then you can Right Click the same food you need to get animals to Breed to...well, do the same thing, just in the pen. Animals like Sheep can be Sheared, same with Bees for Honeycomb.
zh: &5之后用让动物繁殖所需的同种食物右键点击动物栏，就能在栏内完成繁殖。像羊可以剪毛，蜜蜂也可以采蜜脾。

en: &5Then you want to make the &lTransmog Brew! &r&5With this, the person who crafts it can share the Transmogs they've unlocked with someone else!
zh: &5那你就需要制作 &l幻化酿剂&r&5！制作它的人可以把自己已解锁的幻化分享给其他人！

en: &5There are a wide variety of Uniques that you can find, and each has a special location you can find them.
zh: &5你可以找到各种各样的独特物品，而且每种都有特定的出现地点。

en: &5There are also special Trinket Pouch recipes you will have to find and loot!
zh: &5还有一些特殊饰品袋配方需要你在战利品中找到！

en: &5There are new types of Vault Gear to find and use, like the Vault Battlestaff and Vaultarang.
zh: &5你可以找到并使用新的宝库装备类型，例如宝库战杖和宝库回旋镖。

en: &5There are two kinds of doors that will start spawning in the Vaults after level 20.
zh: &520 级之后，宝库中会开始生成两种门。

en: &5There is a special box in the Raw Vault loot pools you might be interested in. It's called the Vaultar Box.
zh: &5原始宝库战利品池里有一个特殊箱子，你可能会感兴趣。它叫宝库祭坛箱。

en: &5There is a special type of Objective, quite difficult to tackle but the only way to obtain certain materials.
zh: &5有一种特殊目标，处理起来相当困难，但它是获取某些材料的唯一途径。

en: &5There is a whole range of Capstones, including some that throw a bit of fun into your Vault. Like the Enchanted Capstone.
zh: &5顶石种类很多，其中有些会给宝库加入一点乐趣，比如附魔顶石。

en: &5There is also a slot for a Deck, so you can build your deck and see all the changes on the left!
zh: &5它还带有一个牌组槽位，因此你可以构筑牌组，并在左侧看到所有变化！

en: &5There is also an Expertise that gives you a higher chance to obtain a Temporal Shard when breaking a Pylon.
zh: &5还有一个专精能提高打破晶塔时获得时空碎片的几率。

en: &5There is also the Big Prophet Seal, which sets it to specifically a 5x5 grid.
zh: &5还有大预言者印记，它会直接把棋盘设为 5x5。

en: &5There used to be a Vault Objective called Hunt the Guardians. You would find challenge Obelisks that would spawn a swarm of tough monsters to fight called Guardians. They eventually replaced that with the Hunt the Runes objective. Slay the Brutal Bosses is kind of a mix of the Slay the Guardians and Hunt the Runes objectives.
zh: &5曾经有个宝库目标叫猎杀守卫。你需要找到挑战方尖碑，触发一群名为守卫的强力怪物战斗。后来它被猎寻符文目标取代。屠戮残暴首领有点像屠戮守卫和猎寻符文的混合版。

en: &5There will be some things not covered, either by accident or because these quests have not been updated to match them yet. If new things are added to either VH Vanilla or Wold's Vaults, it may take a bit before quests are added or updated.
zh: &5仍可能有些内容没有写进任务，可能是遗漏，也可能是任务还没跟上版本。如果原版 VH 或 Wold 的宝库新增内容，任务更新通常需要一点时间。

en: &5There's a bunch of different things you can do to a Crystal. Capstones, Themes, etc. Real interesting.
zh: &5水晶可以做很多不同处理，例如顶石、主题等等，非常有意思。

en: &5There's a lot to go over! You ready?
zh: &5要讲的内容很多，准备好了吗？

en: &5There's a variety of things the Vendor Pedestals can sell, some of them only findable in Vendoor rooms.
zh: &5商贩基座可以出售各种物品，其中有些只能在商贩门房间中找到。

en: &5There's also some items that will ONLY show up in this special slot, so keep an eye on it!
zh: &5还有一些物品只会出现在这个特殊栏位里，所以记得留意！

en: &5There's an Antique Stamp Collector Book you can make to hold all you find. You can even store it in a special Curios slot just for the Stamp Book!
zh: &5你可以制作一本古董邮票收藏册，用来存放找到的邮票。甚至还能把它放在专门给邮票册用的 Curios 槽位里！

en: &5There's an interesting system in the game called Antiques. It's...stamp collecting.
zh: &5游戏里有个有趣的系统叫古董。它……其实就是集邮。

en: &5These animations change depending on what weapons you are using. Swinging a Sword will feel different than swinging a Battlestaff, for example.
zh: &5动画会根据你使用的武器变化。例如挥剑和挥舞战杖的手感会不同。

en: &5These are called Overlevels. And you cannot reach Overlevels with Skill Points alone.
zh: &5这些叫做越级等级。仅靠技能点无法达到越级等级。

en: &5These are like wooden versions of chests. You only break it once to get all the loot, but like Wooden ones it takes longer.
zh: &5它们像木质版的宝箱。只需破坏一次即可获得全部战利品，但和木制宝箱一样，破坏耗时更久。

en: &5These are the things like Attack Damage, Range, and some special abilities only roll as implicits.
zh: &5它们包括攻击伤害、攻击范围，以及一些只会作为固有词缀掷出的特殊能力。

en: &5These are Transmogs, and you can change the model of a piece of gear to a different one you have unlocked.
zh: &5这些就是幻化。你可以把一件装备的模型改成另一个已解锁模型。

en: &5These are usually fairly powerful, especially for specific builds.
zh: &5这些修饰词通常很强，尤其适合某些特定构筑。

en: &5These bosses can vary in shape and abilities, much like the Rune Boss can.
zh: &5这些首领的外形和能力会变化，类似符文首领。

en: &5These cards can be as simple as +1% Item Quantity, or +3 Attack, etc. They can also give you loot, like +2 Vault Gold per 15 Dwellers Killed.
zh: &5这些卡牌的效果可以很简单，比如 +1% 物品数量、+3 攻击等；也可以提供战利品，比如每击杀 15 个潜伏者获得 +2 宝库金币。

en: &5These events can be good or bad. Sometimes they'll spawn a bunch of mobs. Sometimes they'll drop loot.
zh: &5这些事件可能有好有坏。有时会刷出一大群怪物，有时会掉落战利品。

en: &5These ones are a bit more difficult, as you will be fighting a big Boss type enemy. But to summon this boss, you'll need to find Runes.
zh: &5这种宝库难一些，因为你要和大型首领类敌人战斗。要召唤这个首领，你需要找到符文。

en: &5These quests will cover most everything from both VH Vanilla and Wold's Vaults.
zh: &5这些任务会尽量覆盖原版 VH 与 Wold 的宝库中的大多数内容。

en: &5These range from Easy, Normal, Difficult, Challenging, and Impossible.
zh: &5难度从简单、普通、困难、挑战到不可能不等。

en: &5These resources can usually be used to improve or craft gear in the Vault Forge or other Vault Stations.
zh: &5这些资源通常可以在宝库锻造台或其他宝库工作站中用于强化或制作装备。

en: &5These Royale Loot Crates are also scattered in the Vault, looting them will help you gear up to complete the Vault.
zh: &5这些大逃杀战利品箱也会散布在宝库中，搜刮它们能帮助你武装自己并完成宝库。

en: &5These settings changes it for everyone on a server :
zh: &5这些设置会影响服务器上的所有玩家：

en: &5These Smashed Vault Gems can be used to increase the amount of another Vault Gem you are low on.
zh: &5这些碎裂宝库宝石可以用来增加你短缺的另一种宝库宝石数量。

en: &5These will be your main source of Jewels for Vault Tools, and many non-low level crafts require Vault Diamonds.
zh: &5它们会是宝库工具珠宝的主要来源，而许多非低级配方也需要宝库钻石。

en: &5They also fully recharge between Vault runs, thankfully. For now, you can only make Vials, but with the proper Research you can make bigger, better ones.
zh: &5幸好，它们在两次宝库之间也会完全充满。现在你只能制作药瓶，但通过合适研究可以制作更大、更好的版本。

en: &5They are a good way to speed up leveling. The higher level you are, the more Burger ingredients you'll find, to make bigger Burgers.
zh: &5它们是加快升级的好办法。等级越高，你找到的汉堡原料越多，也能做出更大的汉堡。

en: &5They are called Animal Pens, and are good to use early before more options open up.
zh: &5它们叫动物栏，在解锁更多选项前的前期非常好用。

en: &5They are called Augments, and let you lock a specific theme on a Vault Crystal.
zh: &5它们叫增幅器，可以将特定主题锁定到宝库水晶上。

en: &5They are called Corrupted objectives, and are obtained with a special seal you apply to your Crystal.
zh: &5它们叫腐化目标，需要给水晶应用一种特殊印记来获得。

en: &5They are sorted into three colors : Blue, Red, and Green. To equip them, you'll need a Vault Trinket Pouch.
zh: &5饰品分为三种颜色：蓝色、红色和绿色。要装备它们，需要宝库饰品袋。

en: &5They can't really be used as weapons like some other tools can, though...At least not effectively.
zh: &5它们并不太适合作为武器使用，至少效果并不好。

en: &5They contain a lot of the non-Vault resources you need to build a base and gear and machines. Like Iron, Diamonds, Stone, etc.
zh: &5原始宝库里有许多非宝库资源，可用于建基地、做装备和机器，例如铁、钻石、石头等。

en: &5They still have to be spawned at Obelisks, and the fight will be much tougher. But only one Brutal Boss will spawn per Obelisk.
zh: &5它们仍必须在方尖碑处生成，而且战斗会更艰难。不过每个方尖碑只会生成一个残暴首领。

en: &5They'll also contain some of your most common crafting resources.
zh: &5它们也会提供一些最常用的制作资源。

en: &5They'll also occasionally show up in the Black Market and other places.
zh: &5它们偶尔也会出现在黑市和其他地方。

en: &5Things get a bit more difficult for you now...see, now when you die in a Vault, you will lose most of the equipment you are carrying.
zh: &5现在难度会提高一些……从这以后，在宝库中死亡会让你失去携带的大部分装备。

en: &5Things like improving your Black Market or Bounty Tables.

&5Third is Expertise. These are similar to Talents, but tend to be a bit more specific. Raising your Fortune (how much you get from mining ores), or giving you a discount when buying from Vendor Pedestals.
zh: &5第三类是专精。它们和天赋类似，但通常更偏向具体用途，例如提高时运收益，或在商贩基座购买物品时获得折扣。

en: &5This Anvil won't take any damage when used, basically.
zh: &5这个铁砧使用时基本不会损坏。

en: &5This Augment Assembly Table will let ye craft any Themes you have unlocked.
zh: &5这个增幅器组装台可以让你制作任何已经解锁的主题。

en: &5This block can hold tons of cards, and has tabs and a search function to help sort your cards and find specific ones.
zh: &5这个方块能容纳大量卡牌，并带有分页和搜索功能，帮助你整理卡牌并找到特定卡牌。

en: &5This box only contains items the Vault Altar can ask for, even items you haven't hit the level for yet.
zh: &5这个箱子只包含宝库祭坛可能要求的物品，甚至包括你还没达到等级就会需要的物品。

en: &5This can cause issues, however, if the doll contains tons of items, or if the player lags and the doll escapes.
zh: &5不过如果娃娃里有大量物品，或者玩家卡顿导致娃娃逃脱，就可能产生问题。

en: &5This Focus lets you add an Unusual modifier. These are modifiers ye can't usually get on that piece of gear.
zh: &5这种聚焦器可以添加一个异常修饰词。这些修饰词通常不会出现在那件装备上。

en: &5This includes more dangerous themes like Nether or Void themes. As well as the monsters from them.
zh: &5其中也包括下界、虚空这类更危险的主题，以及对应的怪物。

en: &5This is a bit of a double edged sword. The mobs get much stronger, much faster, much deadlier.
zh: &5这有点像双刃剑。怪物会变得更强、更快，也更致命。

en: &5This is a mod called Better Combat, which adds more fluid attacks and animations.
zh: &5这是 Better Combat 模组带来的效果，它加入了更流畅的攻击和动画。

en: &5This is a special Vault Rock that, well...challenges you to complete as many Vaults as you can in a row.
zh: &5这是一种特殊宝库岩，顾名思义，会挑战你连续完成尽可能多的宝库。

en: &5This is a special Vault Theme where it jumbles up rooms from all the other Themes into it.
zh: &5这是一个特殊宝库主题，会把其他所有主题的房间混合到一起。

en: &5This is called Light the Braziers. There is a Brazier in every room. You need to activate a set amount before exiting the Vault in time.
zh: &5这个目标叫点燃火盆。每个房间都有一个火盆，你需要在及时撤离前激活指定数量。

en: &5This is how to 'beat' Vault Hunters : Collect all 25 Artifacts, complete the 'tapestry', and defeat the final boss : The Herald.
zh: &5这就是“通关”宝库猎人的方式：收集全部 25 件神器，完成“挂毯”，并击败最终首领：先驱者。

en: &5This is only a chance, so if you want to guarantee a Companion egg spawning when you hit that Threshold, you'll want to apply a Companion Capstone.
zh: &5这只是概率事件，所以如果你想保证达到阈值时生成伙伴蛋，就需要应用伙伴顶石。

en: &5This is useful, but also detrimental. Some of the Vault Objectives rely on mobs spawning from these spawners. Hunt the Runes is exempt, as activating the Rune Table isn't the same thing.
zh: &5这很有用，但也可能有害。有些宝库目标依赖这些刷怪笼生成怪物。猎寻符文除外，因为激活符文桌并不是同一回事。

en: &5This is, however, a one way process, and you can't take them back out.
zh: &5不过这是单向过程，装进去后不能再取出来。

en: &5This means what prefix or suffix AND what tier they are. And also can roll an empty slot as well, keep that in mind.
zh: &5这包括前缀或后缀是什么，以及它们的阶级。也可能掷出空槽位，记住这一点。

en: &5This means you can nearly fly through Vaults by bunny hopping!
zh: &5这意味着你可以通过连续兔跳，在宝库里几乎飞起来！

en: &5This means you have to hunt specific monsters, which only come from specific themes. Endermen are only in Void themes, for example.
zh: &5这意味着你必须猎杀特定怪物，而它们只出现在特定主题中。例如末影人只会在虚空主题里出现。

en: &5This means, combined with Crystal mode, you can have a crystal ask for easier or harder ingredients sooner than normal, and how many of each ingredient as well.
zh: &5这意味着结合水晶模式后，水晶可以更早要求更简单或更困难的材料，也会影响每种材料的需求数量。

en: &5This one can't be modified further, but the Plunder modifier changes a few things. First off, you get almost no experience in the Vault. Small things might give a bit of XP, but nowhere even close to what you would normally get.
zh: &5这个水晶不能进一步修改，但掠夺修饰词会改变一些内容。首先，你在该宝库中几乎不会获得经验。小事件可能给一点经验，但远低于正常水平。

en: &5This one is a doozy. You think normal Scavenger is hard?
zh: &5这玩意可不好对付。你觉得普通拾荒已经很难？

en: &5This seal ONLY obtained in Mapped Vaults, but its not the only way to Corrupt your crystal....
zh: &5这种印记只会在地图宝库中获得，但它不是腐化水晶的唯一方式……

en: &5This setting effects only your Vaults, and can be different for each person on a server.
zh: &5这个设置只影响你自己的宝库；在服务器上，每个玩家都可以有不同设置。

en: &5This should help you gain Reputation with specific Gods faster.
zh: &5这应该能帮助你更快提高特定神明的声望。

en: &5This Wardrobe lets you not only store a Gear loadout and instantly swap to it, it also lets you store and swap your main hotbar too.
zh: &5这个衣柜不仅能保存一套装备并即时切换，还能保存并切换你的主快捷栏。

en: &5This will let you reroll the gear, but keep the frozen modifier as it is.
zh: &5这会让你能够重掷装备，同时保留被冻结的修饰词不变。

en: &5This'll cause Dungeon Doors to highlight while you are in that Vault. Very helpful.
zh: &5它会让你在该宝库中看到高亮的地牢门，非常有帮助。

en: &5Though an important thing : Wood Chests and all other chests 'break' differently. Wooden Chests have to be broken as a whole, and take time.
zh: &5不过有件重要的事：木制宝箱和其他宝箱的“破坏”方式不同。木制宝箱需要整体破坏，会花一些时间。

en: &5Though it looks like there are some special high cost Enchantments you can get. Probably best saved for higher level gear.
zh: &5不过也有一些高成本的特殊附魔。最好留给更高等级的装备。

en: &5Though it only counts if the item is from an 'unlooted' chest, mind you. No gaming the system with a loophole.
zh: &5不过请注意，物品必须来自“未被搜刮过”的宝箱才会计数。别想着钻漏洞。

en: &5Though many of them are useful outside of the vault too. That double jump one for example, or the wall climbing one.
zh: &5不过许多饰品在宝库外也很有用，比如二段跳或爬墙的那类。

en: &5Though unless the trident has the Loyalty Implicit, you'll have to run over and pick your Trident back up.
zh: &5不过除非三叉戟带有忠诚固有词缀，否则你得自己跑过去把它捡回来。

en: &5Tired of opening Jewel Pouches and Card Booster Packs one by one?
zh: &5厌倦了一个个打开珠宝袋和卡牌补充包？

en: &5To add other tool types to a Vault Tool, you'll need to craft Jewels with the Jewel Crafting Table.
zh: &5要给宝库工具添加其他工具类型，需要使用珠宝制作台制作珠宝。

en: &5To bring a Companion into a Vault, you'll need to put it on your Head Curios Slot.
zh: &5要把伙伴带进宝库，你需要把它放在头部 Curios 槽位上。

en: &5To complete the Vault properly, you'll need to exit out of the Portal.
zh: &5要正常完成这个宝库，你需要从传送门撤离。

en: &5To craft a specific box, you must have that mod Researched.
zh: &5要制作特定盒子，必须先研究对应模组。

en: &5To fix this, you can craft and apply a Chiseling Focus. There are many different Chiseling Focus, and each one removes a specific tool attribute.
zh: &5要解决这个问题，可以制作并使用凿刻聚焦器。凿刻聚焦器有多种，每一种会移除特定工具属性。

en: &5To get into Vaults, you need to 'pay' for crystals. The costs of crystals start out very cheap, but scale up the more you make.
zh: &5进入宝库需要为水晶“支付”材料。水晶一开始很便宜，但制作次数越多，成本会逐渐提高。

en: &5To get more Vault Maps, you can find them in Mapped Vaults, or craft them in the Vault Forge.
zh: &5要获得更多宝库地图，你可以在地图宝库中找到，或在宝库锻炉中制作。

en: &5To get your equipment back, you'll need to Right Click and pick this body up, and bring it to a Spirit Extractor. Then Right Click the body onto it.
zh: &5要取回装备，需要右键拾起这具躯体，把它带到灵魂提取器处，再把躯体右键放到提取器上。

en: &5To help players hunt down the special 'unique' items, you can refer to the Unique Codex.
zh: &5为了帮助玩家追踪特殊的独特物品，可以查看独特典籍。

en: &5To officially complete a Bingo Vault, you'll need to find a Grid Gateway to submit your Bingo Board.
zh: &5要正式完成宾果宝库，你需要找到网格门径并提交你的宾果棋盘。

en: &5To pay for the crystal, just throw the items near the Altar. It will pull them in if they are needed, otherwise it just ignores them. Once the price is paid, put a Button or Lever on the Altar and activate it to create the Vault Crystal.
zh: &5支付材料时，只要把物品扔到祭坛附近即可。需要的物品会被吸入，不需要的会被忽略。材料交齐后，在祭坛上放置按钮或拉杆并激活它，就能生成宝库水晶。

en: &5To retrieve the goods gathered by Vault Dolls, you need to deploy and then kill the doll as it tries to run away.
zh: &5要取回宝库娃娃收集的物品，需要先放出娃娃，然后在它试图逃跑时杀掉它。

en: &5To run a Mapped Vault, you will need a Vault Crystal with the Greedy modifier, obtainable by using a Greedy Vault Rock on a Vault Altar and filling out the ingredients.
zh: &5要运行地图宝库，你需要一枚带有贪婪修饰词的宝库水晶。它可通过把贪婪宝库岩用于宝库祭坛并填充材料获得。

en: &5To summon the Vault Portal, Right Click that Vault Crystal onto the base of the portal frame you just made. It'll consume the crystal and open a portal into the Vault. Don't go in yet!
zh: &5要召唤宝库传送门，将宝库水晶右键点击到刚搭好的传送门框架底部。水晶会被消耗并打开通往宝库的传送门。先别急着进去！

en: &5To that, you can get yourself a Vault Lexicon! It contains entries on most affixes available on Vault Gear, and a description of what they do.
zh: &5因此，你可以给自己做一本宝库词典！它包含大多数宝库装备可用词缀的条目，并说明它们的作用。

en: &5To utilize cards, you'll need to start with the Deck Station, and craft yourself a Starter Deck. Right Click to open the deck and place cards into it, then place the deck in it's Curio slot.
zh: &5要使用卡牌，你需要先制作牌组站，再做一个初始牌组。右键打开牌组并放入卡牌，然后把牌组放到对应 Curios 槽位。

en: &5To win, you must either be the first person to complete the objective, or be the last player standing. Your reward? A trophy!
zh: &5获胜方式是第一个完成目标，或者成为最后存活的玩家。奖励是什么？一座奖杯！

en: &5Treasure Doors, specifically. You'll need a bunch of these Key Pieces, and some Vault Gems to turn into a named Vault Key.
zh: &5具体来说是宝藏门。你需要大量这类钥匙碎片，再加上一些宝库宝石，才能制成有名称的宝库钥匙。

en: &5Unfortunately, you can't drink these inside the Vault.
zh: &5遗憾的是，你不能在宝库里喝这些饮料。

en: &5Unidentified gear only has Level and minimum rarity stats until you roll it. These stats you can alter with the Vault Artisan Station.
zh: &5未鉴定装备在掷出前只有等级和最低稀有度属性。这些属性可以用宝库工匠台调整。

en: &5Uniques are...well, you can figure out that they are Unique items, pieces of equipment mostly, with unique looks and special stats.
zh: &5独特物品嘛……顾名思义，就是独一无二的物品，主要是装备，拥有独特外观和特殊属性。

en: &5Unless you get real lucky and find an unidentified Vault Key.
zh: &5除非你运气特别好，直接找到未鉴定的宝库钥匙。

en: &5Unlike Enchanted Elixir, you should get both a good and a bad event.
zh: &5和附魔灵药不同，你应该会同时得到一个正面事件和一个负面事件。

en: &5Unlike Skills, these are more... indirect buffs to a User, usually involving things not directly combat or looting related.
zh: &5与技能不同，专精更多是间接增益，通常涉及非直接战斗或搜刮的内容。

en: &5Unlike the Treasure Chest, there is only one piece of loot on a Treasure Pedestal. But this is the only way to get two of the rarest treasure rewards: The Treasure Card Deck, and a unique Treasure Magnet.
zh: &5与宝藏箱不同，宝藏基座上只有一件战利品。但这是获得两种最稀有宝藏奖励的唯一方式：宝藏卡牌组和独特宝藏磁铁。

en: &5Upon defeating the Herald, you unlock one of the major end-game systems : Prestige.
zh: &5击败先驱者后，你会解锁一个主要终局系统：威望。

en: &5Useful especially if you have a pile of keys that need using!
zh: &5如果你有一堆钥匙正等着用，这特别有用！

en: &5Users were complaining that they eventually had chests full of the stuff and wanted other uses for it, so...
zh: &5有人抱怨后期箱子里堆满了这东西，希望它能有别的用途，所以……

en: &5Using a Chaotic Focus means one of them will reroll their tier only, and gives it a chance to be higher.
zh: &5使用混沌聚焦器意味着其中一个词缀只会重掷阶级，并有机会变得更高。

en: &5Using an Unidentified Gateway Pearl will get you a random Gateway Pearl. These Pearls can be used to summmon a wave-based challenge. If you don't have a Vault Pearl, you can still Right Click the Gateway block to start a random Gateway instead!
zh: &5使用未鉴定门径珍珠会得到随机门径珍珠。这些珍珠可用于召唤一场波次挑战。如果你没有门径珍珠，也可以直接右键门径方块来开始随机门径！

en: &5Using one gives you the choice between three new modifiers you can put on your Vault Potions.
zh: &5使用后，你可以在三个新的修饰词中选择一个，用于你的宝库药水。

en: &5Using this Jewel Crafting Table and the gemstones you get from Recycling unused Jewels, you can craft and add more Tool types and special abilities to your Vault Tools.
zh: &5使用珠宝制作台，以及回收不用珠宝得到的宝石，你可以为宝库工具制作并添加更多工具类型和特殊能力。

en: &5Usually you will find a Treasure Chest. Full of good loot in it, but not always the best loot.
zh: &5通常你会找到一个宝藏箱。里面装满好东西，但不一定总是最顶级的战利品。

en: &5Vault Axes are one of a variety of weapon types you can use. All weapons gain a broader range of Suffixes and Prefixes as you level up.
zh: &5宝库斧是你可以使用的多种武器类型之一。随着等级提升，所有武器都会获得更广泛的后缀和前缀范围。

en: &5Vault Battlestaves are one of a variety of weapon types you can use. All weapons gain a broader range of Suffixes and Prefixes as you level up.
zh: &5宝库战杖是你可以使用的多种武器类型之一。随着等级提升，所有武器都会获得更广泛的后缀和前缀范围。

en: &5Vault Boots are part of your standard Vault Gear Setup.
zh: &5宝库靴子是标准宝库装备配置的一部分。

en: &5Vault Burgers don't really feed your hunger or anything. Instead, they give you some Vault Experience.
zh: &5宝库汉堡并不会真正补充饥饿值之类的东西，而是会提供一些宝库经验。

en: &5Vault Chestplates are part of your standard Vault Gear Setup.
zh: &5宝库胸甲是标准宝库装备配置的一部分。

en: &5Vault coins are needed for a lot of things : rerolling gear, crafting items, buying back equipment, etc.
zh: &5宝库金币有很多用途：重掷装备、制作物品、赎回装备等等。

en: &5Vault Crystals grown from Budding Crystals create Raw Vaults.
zh: &5由生长水晶长出的宝库水晶会生成原始宝库。

en: &5Vault Foci are one of a variety of Offhand gear types you can use. Most Offhand gear gain a broader range of Suffixes and Prefixes as you level up.
zh: &5宝库聚焦器是你可以使用的多种副手装备之一。随着等级提升，大多数副手装备都会获得更广泛的后缀和前缀范围。

en: &5Vault Foci are usually books or tomes, and focus on boosting up Abilities in general, both combat and non-combat ones.
zh: &5宝库聚焦器通常是书本或典籍，侧重整体强化技能，包括战斗和非战斗技能。

en: &5Vault Fruit enables you to add time to your Vault Timer, to help eke out just a bit more loot or enough time to finish the Objective.
zh: &5宝库水果可以为宝库计时器增加时间，帮助你多拿一点战利品，或争取足够时间完成目标。

en: &5Vault Gear you find in the Vault will be at that Vault's level, not your own. So jumping into your friend's level 5 Vault will only net you level 5 Gear.
zh: &5你在宝库中找到的宝库装备等级取决于那个宝库的等级，而不是你的等级。所以跳进朋友的 5 级宝库，也只会拿到 5 级装备。

en: &5Vault Helmets are part of your standard Vault Gear Setup.
zh: &5宝库头盔是标准宝库装备配置的一部分。

en: &5Vault Hunters has an early game tool to help gather resources from animals in a... less laggy way compared to giant farms.
zh: &5宝库猎人有一种前期工具，可以用比大型农场更不容易卡顿的方式从动物身上获取资源。

en: &5Vault Hunters is an RPG modpack where you tackle procedurally generated dungeons called Vaults.
zh: &5宝库猎人是一个 RPG 整合包，核心玩法是挑战名为“宝库”的程序生成地牢。

en: &5Vault Leggings are part of your standard Vault Gear Setup.
zh: &5宝库护腿是标准宝库装备配置的一部分。

en: &5Vault Pendants can roll bonus levels to Skills, which can help you reach Overlevels.
zh: &5宝库坠饰可以随机到技能额外等级，帮助你达到超等级。

en: &5Vault Plushies are one of a variety of Offhand gear types you can use. Most Offhand gear gain a broader range of Suffixes and Prefixes as you level up.
zh: &5宝库玩偶是你可以使用的多种副手装备之一。随着等级提升，大多数副手装备都会获得更广泛的后缀和前缀范围。

en: &5Vault Plushies focus on survival in a Vault. They can increase damage, give you immunity to specific damage types, boost up your movement abilities, etc.
zh: &5宝库玩偶侧重提高宝库中的生存能力。它们可以增加伤害、免疫特定伤害类型、强化移动能力等。

en: &5Vault Potions (vials, mixes, brews) can be further augmented by using the Alchemy Table.
zh: &5宝库药水（药瓶、合剂、酿剂）可以通过炼金台进一步增强。

en: &5Vault Sacks are one of a variety of Offhand gear types you can use. Most Offhand gear gain a broader range of Suffixes and Prefixes as you level up.
zh: &5宝库袋是你可以使用的多种副手装备之一。随着等级提升，大多数副手装备都会获得更广泛的后缀和前缀范围。

en: &5Vault Sacks focus on improving your looting in the Vault. They can add more loot, better loot, faster movement, trap disarm, etc.
zh: &5宝库袋侧重改善宝库搜刮。它们可以增加战利品、提升战利品质量、提高移动速度、拆除陷阱等。

en: &5Vault Sacks usually don't drop until level 50, but you might be able to find an early one.
zh: &5宝库袋通常要到 50 级后才会掉落，但你也可能提前找到一个。

en: &5Vault Shields are one of a variety of Offhand gear types you can use. Most Offhand gear gain a broader range of Suffixes and Prefixes as you level up.
zh: &5宝库盾牌是你可以使用的多种副手装备之一。随着等级提升，大多数副手装备都会获得更广泛的后缀和前缀范围。

en: &5Vault Shields provide the Implicits to either have a chance at completely blocking an attack, or retaliating with Thorns damage when you are hit.
zh: &5宝库盾牌的固有词缀可以提供完全格挡攻击的几率，或在受到攻击时以荆棘伤害反击。

en: &5Vault Swords are one of a variety of weapon types you can use. All weapons gain a broader range of Suffixes and Prefixes as you level up.
zh: &5宝库剑是你可以使用的多种武器类型之一。随着等级提升，所有武器都会获得更广泛的后缀和前缀范围。

en: &5Vault Tools have a good amount of durability, even at the lower tiers. As you increase your Vault Level, you can make bigger and bigger tools.
zh: &5宝库工具即使在低阶也有不错的耐久。随着宝库等级提高，你可以制作越来越大的工具。

en: &5Vault Tools start with only the type of tool they are. So Pickaxes start with +Picking, Axes with +Axing, etc.
zh: &5宝库工具一开始只具备自身工具类型。例如镐自带 +挖掘，斧自带 +砍伐，依此类推。

en: &5Vault Tridents are one of a variety of weapon types you can use. All weapons gain a broader range of Suffixes and Prefixes as you level up.
zh: &5宝库三叉戟是你可以使用的多种武器类型之一。随着等级提升，所有武器都会获得更广泛的后缀和前缀范围。

en: &5Vault Tridents have more focus on single target damage than the sweeping strikes of the Sword or Battlestaff. They also have the ability to be thrown by holding Right Click to charge it up.
zh: &5宝库三叉戟比剑或战杖的横扫攻击更专注于单体伤害。按住右键蓄力后还可以投掷。

en: &5Vault Wands are one of a variety of Offhand gear types you can use. Most Offhand gear gain a broader range of Suffixes and Prefixes as you level up.
zh: &5宝库法杖是你可以使用的多种副手装备之一。随着等级提升，大多数副手装备都会获得更广泛的后缀和前缀范围。

en: &5Vault Wands focus on adding Ability Power, as well as boosting more combat specific Abilities directly, like Fireball or Nova.
zh: &5宝库法杖侧重增加技能强度，并直接强化一些更偏战斗的技能，例如火球或新星。

en: &5Vault Weapons, Vault Armor... But not ALL Vault Gear...
zh: &5比如宝库武器、宝库护甲……但并不是所有宝库装备都在这里。

en: &5Vaultarangs are a primarily ranged weapon, letting you throw them at the enemy by Right Clicking. They don't do as much damage as up and close weapons, but give you more breathing room to move and dodge.
zh: &5宝库回旋镖主要是远程武器，右键即可投向敌人。它的伤害不如近战武器，但能给你更多移动和闪避空间。

en: &5Vaultarangs are one of a variety of weapon types you can use. All weapons gain a broader range of Suffixes and Prefixes as you level up.
zh: &5宝库回旋镖是你可以使用的多种武器类型之一。随着等级提升，所有武器都会获得更广泛的后缀和前缀范围。

en: &5Vendoors lead to special rooms that have Vendor Pedestals in them. These doors spawn on the walls inside Vault Rooms, usually on the bottom floor.
zh: &5商贩门通往带有商贩基座的特殊房间。这些门会生成在宝库房间的墙上，通常位于底层。

en: &5Versatility makes up for that. You can augment and upgrade your tools with Jewels, which will need its own quests to explain.
zh: &5但多功能性弥补了这一点。你可以用珠宝增幅和升级工具，这部分会用单独的任务解释。

en: &5Want a faster way of crushing bad cards into Card Juice and bad Jewels into Silver Scrap?
zh: &5想更快把差卡碾成卡牌精华，把差珠宝碾成银废料？

en: &5Want a warm drink, especially one with a bit of caffeine in it?
zh: &5想喝点热饮，尤其是带点咖啡因的那种？

en: &5Well, the only thing left in Vanilla VH is : The Herald. You'll have to be level 100, to start with.
zh: &5嗯，原版 VH 剩下的唯一内容就是：先驱者。首先你必须达到 100 级。

en: &5Well, this thing has seen better days. This is the Vault Anvil.
zh: &5嗯，这东西显然经历过不少岁月。这就是宝库铁砧。

en: &5Whatever the case is, you can reroll the current Vault Crystal cost by using an Altar Recatalyzer.
zh: &5无论情况如何，都可以使用祭坛再催化器重掷当前宝库水晶的材料需求。

en: &5When a second player enters the Vault, a two minute timer will start up and lock the Vault so you cannot leave. Once the two minutes are up, all players are teleported to random positions in the Vault.
zh: &5当第二名玩家进入宝库后，两分钟计时器会开始并锁定宝库，期间无法离开。两分钟结束后，所有玩家会被传送到宝库中的随机位置。

en: &5When purchsing something, the Pedestal will pull it directly from your Wallet or Pouches.
zh: &5购买物品时，基座会直接从你的钱包或袋子中扣除费用。

en: &5When running Vaults, Companions have a chance of spawning once you hit a certain XP threshold.
zh: &5跑宝库时，当你达到一定经验阈值后，伙伴有概率生成。

en: &5When someone else drinks the Knowledge Brew, they will gain any Research from it they didn't have yet.
zh: &5其他玩家饮用知识酿剂后，会获得其中自己尚未拥有的研究。

en: &5When the Choromatic Iron Vault Infuser becomes too slow, you can upgrade it into a Chromatic Steel Vault Infuser instead.
zh: &5当彩铁宝库灌注器太慢时，可以把它升级为彩钢宝库灌注器。

en: &5When worn, the Filter Necklace will only void blocks that match the settings in any filters you have inside it.
zh: &5佩戴时，过滤项链只会销毁与内部任意过滤器设置匹配的方块。

en: &5When you apply an Adaptive Focus to a piece of gear in the Artisan Station, it will upgrade the tier of EVERY modifier on it.
zh: &5在工匠台中将自适应聚焦器应用到装备上时，会提升该装备上每一个修饰词的阶级。

en: &5When you apply the Seal, you'll find a couple new 'modifiers' on a Haunted Brazier Crystal.
zh: &5应用印记后，你会发现闹鬼火盆水晶上多了几个新的“修饰词”。

en: &5When you collect enough of a certain stamp, you can get a reward. Just take the Stamps, put them on your hotbar, then select and Right Click them to get the reward.
zh: &5当你收集到足够数量的某种邮票时，就能获得奖励。把邮票放到快捷栏，选中后右键即可领取奖励。

en: &5When you complete a God Altar, you will get a bonus modifier to the rest of that Vault, and the chance at gaining reputation with that God.
zh: &5完成神明祭坛后，你会获得持续到本次宝库结束的额外修饰词，并有机会获得该神声望。

en: &5When you Corrupt a Crystal, the objective will be set to Corrupted, and the Theme will be set to Lost Void.
zh: &5当你腐化一枚水晶时，目标会被设为腐化，主题会被设为失落虚空。

en: &5When you craft the Brew, it will copy all Researches you have.
zh: &5制作这种酿剂时，它会复制你拥有的所有研究。

en: &5When you craft the Mentor's Brew, it will be set to the level you are at the time. When someone else drinks it, their level will raise up to match yours.
zh: &5制作导师酿剂时，它会记录你当时的等级。其他玩家饮用后，等级会提升到与你相同。

en: &5When you enter a Royale Vault, you arrive with no skills or items (You'll get them back when you leave!), and you must gear and skill up while in the Vault.
zh: &5进入大逃杀宝库时，你不会带入任何技能或物品（离开时会还给你！），你必须在宝库内获取装备并提升技能。

en: &5When you enter the Vault, the Portal Room will have a map built into the floor. The different block in the center is your Portal Room. Each block around it is a room.
zh: &5进入宝库后，传送门房间地板上会内置一张地图。中央不同的方块代表你的传送门房间，周围每个方块代表一个房间。

en: &5When you enter this corrupted Vault, your view will be heavily altered. This special view can be disabled by hitting F4 if it is causing you visual or performance problems.
zh: &5进入这个腐化宝库时，你的视野会被大幅改变。如果它造成视觉或性能问题，可以按 F4 禁用这种特殊视图。

en: &5When you fill in every Artifact piece, you're able to....well, I'll come to that later.
zh: &5当你填满每一块神器碎片后，你就能……嗯，这个之后再说。

en: &5When you finally get into a Treasure Room, you'll find one of three things: a Treasure Chest, a single Treasure Pedestal, or THREE Treasure Pedestals!
zh: &5当你终于进入宝藏房时，会看到三种情况之一：一个宝藏箱、一个单独的宝藏基座，或三个宝藏基座！

en: &5When you hit 20, you should wait before going into another Vault!
zh: &5当你达到 20 级时，进入下一个宝库前最好先停一下！

en: &5When you hit Level 100, you can start finding Arcane Essence in completion crates.
zh: &5达到 100 级后，你可以开始在完成宝箱中找到奥术精华。

en: &5When you identify a Vault Map, it will roll a set Objective, Theme, as well as set Modifiers like bonus Item Quantity and similar. There are multiple tiers of Maps to keep a look out for as well!
zh: &5鉴定宝库地图时，它会随机出固定目标、主题，以及固定修饰词，例如额外物品数量之类。还有多个地图等级值得留意！

en: &5When you identify an Artifact, you have a higher chance of finding one you have not identified yet.
zh: &5鉴定神器时，你找到尚未鉴定过神器的几率会更高。

en: &5When you open a Dungeon Door, a popup will tell you what difficulty the creatures that spawn inside are.
zh: &5打开地牢门时，会弹出提示告诉你里面生成生物的难度。

en: &5When you seal a piece of gear, it will lock all stats on it, as well as the transmog, preventing you from changing them.
zh: &5封印装备时，会锁定它的所有属性以及幻化，防止继续更改。

en: &5Which I always highly suggest. More loot means more chance of getting what you really want.
zh: &5我一直很推荐这么做。更多战利品意味着更高几率拿到真正想要的东西。

en: &5Which is an issue as, especially in Wolds, there are LOTS of great blocks you might want to keep for your own builds or resources.
zh: &5这会是个问题，尤其在 Wold 的宝库中，有很多很棒的方块你可能想留作建筑材料或资源。

en: &5Which is how the rooms are laid out. Usually you find vaults as either Diamonds, Circles, or Squares.
zh: &5也就是房间的排列方式。常见宝库通常是菱形、圆形或方形布局。

en: &5While expensive, the Augment Assembly Pedestal is fairly powerful as you unlock more and more Themes.
zh: &5增幅器组装基座虽然昂贵，但随着解锁越来越多主题，会变得相当强力。

en: &5While fairly rare in the early levels, you'll eventually start finding Vault Gear with +Levels to these. With these, you can reach Overlevel in Skills and Talents.
zh: &5虽然前期比较少见，但之后你会逐渐找到带有技能/天赋等级加成的宝库装备。借助这些加成，就能让技能和天赋达到越级等级。

en: &5While the Pyretic Focus will increase the rarity of the gear piece.
zh: &5而炽热聚焦器会提升这件装备的稀有度。

en: &5While this might be quite expensive to start with, you'll want to get one of these up and running.
zh: &5虽然一开始可能很贵，但你会想尽快让其中一个投入使用。

en: &5While Vault Gear replaces your Vanilla armor and weapons, Vault Tools replace your various vanilla Tools.
zh: &5宝库装备会替代原版护甲和武器，而宝库工具会替代各种原版工具。

en: &5With a God Offering and the accompanying theme Augment, you can create a special God item that works like a Vault Rock.
zh: &5使用神明供品和对应主题增幅器，可以制作一种特殊神明物品，它的用法类似宝库岩。

en: &5With death changing at level 20, you might be feeling a bit under geared, or unprepared, or just don't want to deal with losing your inventory, you can make a Warden's Vault Rock.
zh: &520 级后死亡机制改变，如果你觉得装备不足、准备不充分，或者单纯不想处理丢背包，可以制作守卫者宝库岩。

en: &5With enough time and work, you can unlock ALL of the Expertises!
zh: &5只要投入足够时间和精力，你可以解锁所有专精！

en: &5With Parcool, you can do double jumps, long jumps, climb up ledges, wall kick, tuck and roll, and more. You can see all the things you do in this book.
zh: &5使用 Parcool 后，你可以二段跳、长跳、攀上边缘、蹬墙、翻滚等。本书里可以查看这些动作。

en: &5With the Enchanted Capstone, it'll add a custom modifier: Enchanted. Every so often some sort of event will happen while you run that Vault. If this works, I have an idea brewing...
zh: &5使用附魔顶石后，它会添加一个自定义修饰词：附魔。跑这个宝库时，每隔一段时间就会触发某种事件。如果这个机制正常，我已经有点新想法了……

en: &5Wolds adds alternate versions of most of the Vanilla VH Vault Objectives. These provide a bigger challenge, but give a bigger reward.
zh: &5Wold 为大多数原版 VH 宝库目标加入了替代版本。这些目标挑战更大，但奖励也更高。

en: &5Wooden Chests will be the most common chest you find in the Vaults.
zh: &5木制宝箱会是你在宝库中最常见的宝箱。

en: &5Ye place these on a Vault Altar like a normal Vault Rock, and pay the price for the crystal as usual. But the Vault Crystal ye get back will be marked with Afterlife.
zh: &5像普通宝库岩一样把它放到宝库祭坛上，并照常支付水晶材料。但返回的宝库水晶会带有来世标记。

en: &5Ye use it on a Vault Altar like a normal Vault Rock, and pay the price to turn it into a special Vault Crystal.
zh: &5像普通宝库岩一样把它用于宝库祭坛，并支付材料把它变成特殊宝库水晶。

en: &5Yep, Bingo! But its a very different version of Bingo. You get a board. It isn't 5x5, it's 4x4. You can see the full board by holding TAB, and use Scroll Wheel to select which line you track at the top of your screen.
zh: &5没错，宾果！但这是非常不同的宾果。你会得到一张棋盘，不是 5x5，而是 4x4。按住 TAB 可以查看完整棋盘，并用滚轮选择屏幕顶部追踪哪一条线。

en: &5You can activate one of these Altars to get a timed challenge from that 'Vault God'. If ye complete it, you get a reward! If not, a punishment...
zh: &5你可以激活其中一个祭坛，接受该“宝库神”的限时挑战。完成就有奖励，失败则会受到惩罚……

en: &5You can add more than 5 runes to increase the rewards, but keep in mind that at 20, 40, and 60 runes the Boss will get extra special abilities.
zh: &5你可以放入超过 5 个符文来增加奖励，但要注意在 20、40、60 个符文时，首领会获得额外特殊能力。

en: &5You can also dye the Companion Home the same way you dye Leather Armor (put any number of dyes + the home in a crafting table).
zh: &5你也可以像给皮革护甲染色一样给伙伴之家染色（把任意数量的染料和伙伴之家放进工作台）。

en: &5You can also find Catalyst Boxes, which will give you a random Catalyst.
zh: &5你也可以找到催化剂箱，它会给你一个随机催化剂。

en: &5You can also identify all the Vault Gear in a backpack by Right Clicking said backpack onto the Identification Stand.
zh: &5你也可以把装有宝库装备的背包右键放到鉴定台上，一次性鉴定背包里的所有宝库装备。

en: &5You can also turn the Mystery Egg into a Hostile version. These ones will drop, well, hostile Spawn Eggs.
zh: &5你也可以把神秘蛋转换成敌对版本。敌对神秘蛋会掉落敌对生物的刷怪蛋。

en: &5You can change how fast or slow you level up, as well as how much loot you get in a Vault.
zh: &5你可以调整升级速度，也可以调整宝库中的战利品数量。

en: &5You can change how XP is shared in a Vault with a new gamerule. With the gamrule, you can change it so you combine the XP and split it evenly between all Vault runners, or you can match XP to the highest OR lowest XP gained.
zh: &5你可以用新的游戏规则调整宝库经验共享方式。它可以把所有人的经验合并后平均分配，也可以让队伍经验匹配最高或最低的获得量。

en: &5You can find Chromatic Iron and Vault Stone two ways :
zh: &5彩铁和宝库岩主要有两种获取方式：

en: &5You can find Soul Ichor, which lets you reroll the current Black Market offerings.
zh: &5你可以找到灵魂灵液，用来重掷当前黑市商品。

en: &5You can find them in various ways, usually in specific rooms, or on the Black Market, or in Vendoors.
zh: &5它们可以通过多种方式获得，通常在特定房间、黑市或商贩门中出现。

en: &5You can get a good selection of Runes to build up the Boss how you want. Just take the Runes back to the first room, put them in the Pedestal, and then kill the boss. Easy peasy.
zh: &5你可以用不同符文组合出想要的首领。把符文带回第一个房间，放入基座，然后击杀首领。简单，对吧。

en: &5You can get Augment Pieces by recycling unused Augments.
zh: &5回收不用的增幅器可以获得增幅器碎片。

en: &5You can get more use out of this gear if you Recycle it!
zh: &5如果把这些装备回收掉，就能榨出更多价值！

en: &5You can get some value out of these cards by throwing them into your Vault Recycler, turning them into Card Juice.
zh: &5你可以把这些卡牌丢进宝库回收机，把它们转化为卡牌精华，从中获得一些价值。

en: &5You can have a friend make a Vault Doll, and it'll bear their name and character skin.
zh: &5你可以让朋友制作一个宝库娃娃，它会带有朋友的名字和角色皮肤。

en: &5You can make a bigger portal frame as well to better fit into your base build.
zh: &5你也可以做更大的传送门框架，让它更适合你的基地布局。

en: &5You can make an &lAscension Forge &r&5to spend your Embers on. Ye can buy special Transmogs, or Titles that'll show up with your name in Chat.
zh: &5你可以制作 &l飞升熔炉&r&5 来花费余烬。你可以购买特殊幻化，或会在聊天中随名字显示的称号。

en: &5You can make one in the Vault Forge if you haven't gotten one from looting.
zh: &5如果还没从战利品里拿到，也可以在宝库锻造台制作一个。

en: &5You can only add one kind of Capstone per crystal, but they tend to be pretty powerful. Like the Phoenix Capstone, which will resurrect you on the spot if you die inside the Vault.
zh: &5每个水晶只能添加一种顶石，但顶石通常都很强力。比如凤凰顶石会在你死于宝库内时当场复活你。

en: &5You can only repair them a set number of times, though. But early on you'll be upgrading your tools regularly anyways.
zh: &5不过它们只能修理固定次数。但在前期，你本来也会经常升级工具。

en: &5You can place one piece of Vault Gear into the Imbuement Altar to gamble on upgrading a modifier on it.
zh: &5你可以把一件宝库装备放入灌注祭坛，赌一次升级它上面某个修饰词的机会。

en: &5You can place the Artifact Tome down, and it'll project a 5x5 hologram on the wall behind it.
zh: &5你可以放下神器典籍，它会在背后的墙上投影出 5x5 全息图。

en: &5You can put your spirit onto a Spirit Extractor, then pay the listed Vault Gold to get your items back.
zh: &5把你的灵魂放到灵魂提取器上，然后支付显示的宝库金币即可取回物品。

en: &5You can read over and put your skill points in the Vault Hunters GUI (default key: H). This is also where you can find the built-in quests.
zh: &5你可以在宝库猎人界面查看并分配技能点，默认按键是 H。内置任务也能在这里找到。

en: &5You can recycle these Trinkets in a Vault Recycler, and you'll sometimes get back Vault Trinket Scrap.
zh: &5可以把这些饰品放进宝库回收机回收，有时会返还宝库饰品残片。

en: &5You can regenerate a Heart on a Companion by feeding it a Companion Snack. HOWEVER, you cannot heal a Companion that is RETIRED!
zh: &5你可以喂伙伴伙伴零食来恢复一颗心。不过，你不能治疗已经退休的伙伴！

en: &5You can see the final stats of the tool before applying all the Jewels in the table.
zh: &5应用所有珠宝之前，你可以在工作台中预览工具的最终属性。

en: &5You can set the target of the Compass outside the Vault for free, but changing it in the middle of a Vault will cost 10% of your Health. (You'll get this back after the Vault, of course)
zh: &5你可以在宝库外免费设置指南针目标，但在宝库中途更改目标会消耗你 10% 生命值。（当然，宝库结束后会返还。）

en: &5You can slap on an extra ability onto the Potion that activates when it is consumed. Such as replenishing Mana as well as your Hitpoints.
zh: &5你可以给药水附加额外能力，在饮用时触发，例如在恢复生命值的同时补充法力。

en: &5You can take one of the Spawn Eggs you get from the Mystery Eggs and put it into this.
zh: &5你可以把神秘蛋中获得的刷怪蛋放进去。

en: &5You can take the Etched Vault Layout, and combine it with a Vault Crystal in an Anvil to set the layout of the Vault.
zh: &5你可以把蚀刻宝库布局和宝库水晶放入铁砧合成，从而设定宝库布局。

en: &5You can test your fighting builds this way. If you die in a Trial Chamber Vault, you shouldn't lose anything.
zh: &5你可以用这种方式测试战斗构筑。如果在试炼大厅宝库中死亡，应该不会损失任何东西。

en: &5You cannot effect anything in this mode, and the server can change settings to allow you to freely roam around or keep you locked to a player.
zh: &5在这个模式下你无法影响任何东西；服务器可以修改设置，允许你自由移动，或把你锁定到某个玩家身上。

en: &5You could always add a Seal for an Objective you are good at completing.
zh: &5你也可以给自己擅长完成的目标添加一个印记。

en: &5You don't hunt down Runes to build your own boss, instead you search rooms for an Obelisk. This will summon a Brutal Boss.
zh: &5你不再猎寻符文来组装自己的首领，而是在房间里寻找方尖碑。它会召唤一个残暴首领。

en: &5You don't NEED to Research mods, but it limits how fast you can make new Vaults, as the cost scales up with each crystal you make.
zh: &5你并不是必须研究模组，但不研究会限制你制作新宝库的速度，因为每制作一个水晶，材料成本都会继续上涨。

en: &5You find them in Gilded Chests usually, and holding and Right Clicking them will give you a random Jewel with an ability on it.
zh: &5它们通常出现在镀金宝箱中，手持并右键使用后，会给你一个带能力的随机珠宝。

en: &5You get 25 minutes, by default, to "Complete" a Vault. And by Complete, you should see a thing at the top of your view that talks about Elixir.
zh: &5默认情况下，你有 25 分钟来“完成”一个宝库。所谓完成，就是你会在视野顶部看到一个与灵药相关的目标条。

en: &5You get a Completion Crate for completing the objective. These Crates contain a variety of rewards depending on what Objective it's from. You'll need to place it on the ground, then Sneak + Right Click to open it up.
zh: &5完成目标后会获得一个完成奖励箱。奖励箱内容会根据目标类型有所不同。把它放在地上，然后潜行并右键点击即可打开。

en: &5You get enough Bingo spots to get a line, and you have completed the Bingo objective. But get more lines, and you get more loot in the crate! Get a full blackout and, well...
zh: &5完成足够的宾果格子连成一条线，就完成了宾果目标。但连线越多，宝箱里的战利品越好！如果全盘涂满，那就……

en: &5You get Nullite from two sources : Ore POIs and the Completion Crate.
zh: &5虚无岩有两个来源：矿石兴趣点和完成宝箱。

en: &5You get them from defeating enemies in the Vault. It's sort of... a piece of their fighting spirit. A reward for defeating them, basically.
zh: &5击败宝库中的敌人会获得它。某种意义上，那像是敌人战斗意志的碎片，也就是击败它们的奖励。

en: &5You might as well know : other than the final boss fight with the Herald, you also open up the &lChallenger's Vault Rock.
zh: &5你也该知道：除了和先驱者的最终首领战之外，你还会解锁 &l挑战者宝库岩。

en: &5You might have noticed getting one of these from a Completion Crate.
zh: &5你可能已经从完成奖励箱里拿到过其中一个。

en: &5You only get one Expertise point every 5 levels, and it is expensive to reset them, so choose carefully!
zh: &5每 5 级才会获得 1 个专精点，而且重置费用很高，所以请谨慎选择！

en: &5You probably already know the answer to this question. It's probably why you are playing this pack, or started playing Vault Hunters (Which I'll call Vanilla VH from here on). But in summary :
zh: &5你大概已经知道答案了，也可能正是因为它才来玩这个整合包，或开始接触宝库猎人（后面我会把原版宝库猎人简称为原版 VH）。简单来说：

en: &5You should be getting some new Focus' to use in the Vault Artisan Station. Like the Waxing and Waning Foci.
zh: &5你应该会开始拿到一些新的聚焦器，用在宝库工匠台里，比如盈蜡聚焦器和亏蜡聚焦器。

en: &5You will need Wold Star Chunks, which are only found in Treasure Chests, Treasure Pedestals, Omega Vendor Pedestals, and Omega Boxes.
zh: &5你会需要 Wold 星辰碎块，它们只会在宝藏箱、宝藏基座、欧米伽商贩基座和欧米伽盒中找到。

en: &5You would go through Anvils like sliced bread sometimes. So the devs implemented a new item: The Vault Anvil.
zh: &5那时候铁砧有时消耗得像切片面包一样快。所以开发者加入了新物品：宝库铁砧。

en: &5You'll also have at least one Royale Loot Crate in the main room, containing up to 5 items from the following list :
zh: &5主房间里还至少会有一个大逃杀战利品箱，最多包含以下列表中的 5 件物品：

en: &5You'll also want a handful of Vault Rocks, which you need to make Vault Crystals. Here's a couple extra.
zh: &5你还需要准备一些宝库岩，用来制作宝库水晶。这里先额外给你几个。

en: &5You'll be needing a bit more Elixir to complete the Vault, for starters.
zh: &5首先，你需要更多灵药才能完成宝库。

en: &5You'll find bigger and better Fruit the higher you level up. Some of them have special side effects as well.
zh: &5等级越高，你会找到更大、更好的水果。其中一些还带有特殊副作用。

en: &5You'll get a Shulker Box and a free skill point before your first Vault, both of which are super helpful. The Shulker will let you extract with more loot, and you'll be able to replace them pretty soon.
zh: &5在第一个宝库之前，你会获得一个潜影盒和一个免费技能点，这两样都非常有用。潜影盒能让你带出更多战利品，而且很快就能补充新的。

en: &5You'll get the full array of options to choose from, but with an extra option to recycle the pack or pouch immediately.
zh: &5你仍会得到完整的选项列表供选择，但会额外多一个选项，可以立即回收该包或袋子。

en: &5You'll have some parkouring to do to reach the Herald's arena. The statue in the center will start the fight.
zh: &5你需要进行一些跑酷才能到达先驱者的竞技场。中央的雕像会开始战斗。

en: &5You'll need 3 Ingredients before you can put them into a Brewing Altar. If an ingredient has a modifier attached, it'll have a chance of being added when you brew it unless you add 3 of the same ingredient!
zh: &5你需要先有 3 个材料，才能把它们放入酿造祭坛。如果某个材料附带修饰词，酿造时它有概率被加入；除非你加入 3 个相同材料！

en: &5You'll need room to make the Vault Portal, as well as space for a lot of crafting stations and item storage.
zh: &5你需要留出建造宝库传送门的空间，也要给大量工作站和物品存储预留位置。

en: &5You'll need to find a Treasure Door to use it on, one that matches the Key you have. They'll be in the same spots in the Vault walls that Vendoors and Dungeon Doors are.
zh: &5你需要找到一扇匹配手中钥匙的宝藏门来使用它。它们会出现在宝库墙上与商贩门、地牢门相同的位置。

en: &5You'll need to start with some Animal Jars. You can Sneak + Right Click them onto most common animals (Cows, Pigs, Sheep, etc) to "Jar" them.
zh: &5你需要先制作一些动物罐。按住潜行并右键点击大多数常见动物（牛、猪、羊等），即可把它们“装罐”。

en: &5You'll need two of an animal to be useful. You can then take an Animal Jar with some animals in it, and Right Click it onto a placed Animal Pen.
zh: &5要让一种动物发挥作用，需要至少两只。然后拿着装有动物的动物罐，右键点击已放置的动物栏。

en: &5You'll notice each Vault Crystal you put in has a "Capacity". This is how much of certain things, primarily Catalysts, you can add to the Crystal. You CANNOT go over Capacity in Wold's.
zh: &5你会注意到每个放入的宝库水晶都有“容量”。容量决定了你能往水晶上添加多少特定内容，主要是催化剂。在 Wold 的宝库里不能超过容量上限。

en: &5You'll quickly notice that you'll start getting more and more Vault Gear, and most of it won't be useful to you... as it is right now.
zh: &5你很快会发现自己拿到的宝库装备越来越多，而其中大多数暂时并不适合你使用。

en: &5You'll start collecting lots of cards in due time, especially if you are lucky enough to find certain Vault rooms.
zh: &5随着时间推进，你会开始收集大量卡牌，尤其是如果你足够幸运找到了某些宝库房间。

en: &5You'll start collecting tons of useless commons. Well, they aren't useless, but they are taking up room.
zh: &5你会开始收集大量没用的普通卡。嗯，也不是完全没用，只是很占地方。

en: &5You'll want to collect as many of these as you can, they are very useful. You'll get a way to store them later, but for now treat it like any other piece of loot.
zh: &5尽量多收集灵魂碎片，它们非常有用。后面会有专门存放它们的办法，现在先把它当作普通战利品处理。

en: &5You'll want to make and apply the Affinity for every chest on your Vault Tool, as it greatly speeds up yer looting.
zh: &5你会想给宝库工具添加每种宝箱亲和，因为这会大幅加快搜刮速度。

en: &5You've been digging up all the Treasure Sand in the Treasure Rooms, right?
zh: &5宝藏房里的所有宝藏沙，你一直都有挖吧？

en: &5You've definitely noticed that when you roll a new piece of gear, if it has a model you've not seen before, you'll get notified that you've "unlocked" it.
zh: &5你肯定注意到了：当你掷出一件新装备，如果它的模型你之前没见过，系统会提示你“解锁”了它。

en: &5You've most likely already hit Level 5, so you probably already noticed you gained an Expertise Point.
zh: &5你大概率已经到 5 级了，所以应该也注意到自己获得了一个专精点。

en: &5You've probably been through a Vault or two already, and you've already gotten quite a few Soul Shards, yes?
zh: &5你大概已经跑过一两个宝库，也拿到不少灵魂碎片了，对吧？

en: &5Your crystals at low level can't be modified too much, but will expand as you get to higher levels.
zh: &5低等级时你的水晶能修改的内容不多，但随着等级提高，可修改空间会逐渐扩大。

en: &5Your first available objective is called Elixir Rush, or simply Elixir. Your goal is to fill up that bar with Elixir, which are these purple orbs that 'explode' out of enemies and chests.
zh: &5你最先遇到的目标叫灵药冲刺，也可以简称灵药。你的目标是用灵药填满进度条，灵药就是从敌人和宝箱中“爆”出来的那些紫色光球。

en: &5Your goal? Reach level 100, find the 25 artifacts, and challenge the Herald.
zh: &5你的目标？达到 100 级，找齐 25 件神器，然后挑战先驱。

en: &5Your Vault GUI has a section called VHat Can I Roll? Which gives you information about all sorts of Vault Gear. This is a simplified verison of that for Uniques. Might be helpful to you.
zh: &5你的宝库界面里有一个叫“我能掷出什么？”的区域，会提供各种宝库装备信息。这里是针对独特物品的简化版本，应该能帮上忙。

en: The Void Crucible serves several key functions within the Vault. Firstly, it allows you to configure a blacklist—a list of blocks that will not be voided when picked up during a Vault run. This gives players greater control over which blocks are preserved. Additionally, the Crucible houses the crafting interface for Void Stones, which are created using Vault Gold and Vault Alloy. The Crystal tab lets you preview the various blocks that can generate in specific room themes, helping with planning and preparation. Unlike the previous charm system, the inventory size cannot be upgraded, making inventory management more strategic than ever.
